jobs.title: Cloud Security Lead
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Join us at the forefront of AI and cloud-native security as we work to secure one of the most innovative developer platforms in the world. As the Cloud Security Lead, you will shape the cloud and infrastructure security program that protects millions of developers, enables safe AI-assisted development, and ensures organizations can confidently bring our platform into enterprise environments.

In this role, you will own cloud security across GCP (primary) and supplemental environments in AWS and Azure, as well as containerized systems, SaaS platforms, and our multi-tenant AI infrastructure. You’ll improve our security posture through strong architecture, posture management, secure-by-default development practices, and close partnership with Engineering, Compliance, Security Architecture, and Platform teams.

This is a highly impactful, hands-on leadership role—perfect for someone who wants to solve complex security challenges at scale while influencing product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:


CLOUD SECURITY ENGINEERING

 - Lead configuration hardening across GCP, with additional oversight of workloads and integrations running in AWS and Azure.

 - Own and optimize CSPM platforms across multi-cloud environments—establishing configuration baselines, guardrails, and remediation workflows.

 - Secure critical SaaS platforms, ensuring proper configurations, access controls, and engineering integrations.

 - Lead infrastructure vulnerability management across multi-cloud systems, containers, registries, and platform services.

 - Enhance security across containerized and Kubernetes (GKE/EKS/AKS) workloads, including runtime protections, network policies, and workload identity.

 - Assess secure logging configurations across cloud/SaaS providers, ensuring audit logs, retention, and routing meet monitoring and architecture needs.
   


SECURE DEVELOPMENT & ARCHITECTURE ENABLEMENT

 - Partner with engineering teams to make services secure by default, embedding security into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments.
   


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Collaborate with Security Monitoring, Compliance/GRC, Architecture, DevOps, Platform Engineering, and ML Infrastructure.

 - Participate in communicating security advisories, best practices, and updates to Replit’s customers.

 - Support incident investigations as a cloud security subject-matter expert.




REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

 - 7+ years of experience in cloud engineering, with 3+ years in a senior or lead role.

 - Hands-on experience with CSPM tools (Wiz, Lacework, Prisma, Orca, SCC, etc.).

 - Deep expertise in GCP security (IAM, VPC, KMS, GKE, Cloud Logging).

 - Experience securing and governing SaaS platforms and identity integrations.

 - Operational experience with infrastructure vulnerability management across cloud and container environments.

 - Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure security services and configurations.

 - Experience with container and Kubernetes security across GKE, EKS, or AKS.

 - Strong IaC security experience with Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tooling.

 - Familiarity with compliance standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS).




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience supporting engineering teams in building secure-first, cloud-native or PaaS environments.

 - Background securing AI/ML pipelines, model-serving infrastructure, or developer platform services.

 - Experience in high-growth technology or cloud-native product companies.

 - Experience with securing AI/agentic systems and sensitive data pipelines.

 - Automation/scripting with Python.

 - Relevant certifications (e.g., GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, AWS/Azure security certs).
   
   


WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset — Ability to break down complex security and operational challenges into clear engineering solutions.

 - Autonomy — Comfortable leading initiatives, collaborating effectively,  and driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

 - Communication excellence — Able to translate deep technical concepts for engineers, executives, and enterprise customers.

 - Continuous learning — Passion for staying current with AI security, cloud-native advances, and emerging threats.

 - Automation-first approach — Belief in reducing operational toil and building scalable, self-healing systems.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

As the first BDR Manager in our London office, you will lead the onsite team building Ramp’s presence across the European market. In this high-velocity front-line manager role, you will develop and coach a team of Business Development Representatives, and work closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and the executive team to define and scale Ramp’s BDR motion across the UK and Europe.

This is a player-coach role: you will lead from the front, contribute directly to key prospecting initiatives, and help recruit and develop the team. jobs.description:
Why Rogo

Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them.

This is a unique opportunity to join a generational company driving transformation in one of the most important industries in the world. With a rapidly growing, global client base, proven product-market fit, and backing from world-class investors, we are scaling quickly and defining a new category of enterprise AI.

Our team is sharp, motivated, and deeply committed to Rogo’s mission. We take ownership of complex problems and stay relentlessly focused on our users. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, demand excellence, and want to help build the future of finance, we invite you to join us.

The Role

We’re hiring our first UK-based People Operations Manager to build and scale our People function across the UK and EMEA. Reporting to our People Lead, you’ll be a trusted partner to leaders and employees, shaping the employee experience as we grow.

You’ll have the autonomy to set priorities, build solutions, and drive them from idea to execution. We’re looking for someone who pairs strong judgment with hands-on execution and brings clarity and structure to a fast-moving business.

What You’ll Own

People Programs & Systems

  • EMEA Expansion: Shape our People approach as we enter new markets, anticipating hiring and operational needs and building infrastructure that scales.

  • Onboarding: Build a thoughtful, efficient onboarding experience that sets new hires up for success.

  • Performance & Engagement: Run performance review and engagement survey cycles, equipping managers with clear guidance and turning feedback into action.

  • Tools & Data: Own People systems, workflows, and data accuracy across the employee lifecycle. Improve automations and integrations to keep operations running smoothly.

Benefits, Immigration & Compliance

  • Benefits: Manage and evolve our benefits programs, partnering with providers to deliver a seamless employee experience.

  • Immigration & Mobility: Own visa sponsorship, renewals, and international relocations, coordinating with Recruiting, Legal, and external counsel to keep processes moving and employees informed.

  • HR Compliance: Maintain employment policies, documentation, and compliance processes, working with Legal and external advisors to navigate requirements across markets.

Culture & Manager Partnership

  • Manager Support: Be a trusted partner on team growth, performance, feedback, and day-to-day people decisions. Build practical resources that strengthen management practices.

  • Culture & Connection: Create meaningful opportunities for connection and recognition as the team grows.

  • Communication: Keep employee resources clear and current, and make People programs easy to understand and navigate.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with the People Lead to set priorities and adapt company-wide programs to local needs.

  • Work with Finance, Legal, Recruiting, and Leadership to drive expansion and operational improvements.

  • Spot gaps, recommend solutions, and lead projects through implementation.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of People Operations or HR experience in a high-growth environment.

  • Experience supporting rapid expansion across EMEA, including scaling operations across countries and navigating local employment practices.

  • Hands-on experience with UK immigration and visa sponsorship, plus exposure to immigration and employee mobility across EMEA.

  • A track record of building effective programs and processes with minimal direction.

  • Strong judgment—you connect employee needs with business priorities and know when to act independently or bring in a partner.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to drive initiatives across teams from start to finish.

  • Experience owning HR systems, workflows, and automations; Rippling experience highly preferred.

  • Clear communication, high emotional intelligence, and discretion with sensitive information.

  • A bias toward action—you find answers, sweat the details, and follow through.

Who You Are

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments. You are high-intensity and care a lot about what you do, and you're ecstatic to work at a startup.

  • You are ambitious. You have fun solving problems that others think are impossible.

  • You are curious. You find joy in learning about AI, technology, and finance.

  • You are an owner. You are autonomous, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity.

  • You are collaborative, organized, thoughtful, and kind.

Why Join Rogo?

  • Up and to the right: Rogo has strong product adoption with the world's leading financial institutions, and we are still early. The upside is enormous.

  • Extraordinary team: we take talent density seriously. You'll do the best work of your career alongside some of the sharpest people in AI and finance.

  • A one-of-one problem: bringing AI to the core of how Wall Street works is one of the most ambitious, technically demanding, and consequential problems today. There is nowhere else you can work on it at this scale.

  • Real ownership: You'll own real surface area and watch the world's most sophisticated users rely on your work.

  • Always at the frontier: we work at the edge of what the best models can do and turn it into products people trust. If you're obsessed with AI, this is where it's happening.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

 

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

About this role

We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to lead and evolve our performance marketing function across regions.

This is a high-impact role for an experienced performance marketer who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, bringing deep expertise in paid acquisition and a strong understanding of full-funnel growth in a B2B SaaS environment.

You will act as the central connector between brand, regional marketing, partnerships, and our external performance agency, ensuring performance marketing not only drives demand, but also improves conversion and contributes directly to pipeline and revenue.

You will be responsible for ensuring performance marketing effectively connects local brand awareness and demand creation (TOFU) through to conversion and revenue (MOFU/BOFU), adapting strategies to reflect market-specific dynamics, verticals, and customer behaviour across geographies.

 
 

How you’ll make an impact

Success in this role will come from building a scalable, insight-driven performance engine that drives measurable business growth across markets, within our ICP and target segments:

  • Driving pipeline and revenue growth through performance marketing across regions

  • Connecting brand, demand creation, and conversion into a cohesive full-funnel strategy

  • Ensuring performance marketing supports inbound, outbound and partner-led growth

  • Delivering locally relevant performance strategies that reflect market maturity and vertical focus

  • Improving conversion rates and efficiency across the funnel

  • Providing clear visibility into what is driving demand, conversion, and revenue across geographies

  • Strengthening collaboration between performance, brand, regional teams, and sales

 

What you’ll do

Performance Strategy & Planning

  • Define and execute a holistic performance marketing strategy aligned to business, regional and vertical priorities

  • Translate pipeline and revenue targets into channel strategies, budget allocation, and investment plans

  • Ensure a full-funnel approach across all geographies, connecting:

    • Brand awareness and demand creation (TOFU)

    • Consideration and engagement (MOFU)

    • Conversion and revenue generation (BOFU)

  • Identify and prioritise new growth opportunities across channels, audiences, and markets

 

Channel Performance & Optimisation

  • Own performance across all paid acquisition channels (e.g. search, social, display, affiliates)

  • Drive continuous testing and experimentation across targeting, creative, landing pages, and funnel

  • Optimise for end-to-end performance (traffic → lead → opportunity → revenue), not just lead volume

  • Ensure budget is allocated effectively based on performance, incrementality, and scalability

  • Adapt channel strategies to reflect local market context, verticals, and customer behaviour

 

Demand, Conversion & Insights

  • Own performance reporting and insights across:

    • Pipeline and revenue contribution

    • Conversion rates across funnel stages

    • Cost efficiency (CPL, CAC, LTV:CAC)

  • Provide clear, actionable insights to:

    • Regional marketing teams (what’s driving local demand)

    • Brand team (what messaging and creative is converting)

    • Sales and leadership (pipeline quality and opportunities)

  • Surface early signals on opportunities and risks across markets

  • Ensure clear visibility of how TOFU activity translates into MOFU/BOFU outcomes across geographies

 

Agency & Stakeholder Management

  • Own and lead the relationship with our global performance marketing agency, ensuring:

    • High-quality execution and optimisation

    • Strategic input and proactive recommendations

    • Clear accountability against KPIs

  • Ensure agency output reflects local market needs, not just global scale

  • Act as the key liaison between brand, regional teams, partnerships, RevOps and external partners

  • Align stakeholders on performance, priorities, and growth opportunities

 

Technology & Tracking

  • Ensure all paid channels are accurately tracked, measured, and integrated across systems (e.g. Salesforce, marketing automation)

  • Partner with RevOps and Data teams to improve attribution, tracking, and reporting infrastructure

  • Ensure full-funnel visibility across geographies, connecting campaign performance to revenue outcomes

Leadership

  • Set clear priorities, goals, and development plans

  • Foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, and continuous improvement

 

What you’ll bring with you

  • Experience: 7+ years experience in performance marketing, ideally within B2B SaaS

  • Strategic mindset: Strong ability to translate business goals into scalable performance strategies

  • Performance expertise: Proven track record of driving pipeline and revenue growth through paid channels

  • Full-funnel understanding: Experience connecting brand, demand generation, and conversion (TOFU → MOFU → BOFU)

  • Multi-market experience: Experience adapting strategies across different geographies and market maturities

  • Collaboration: Skilled at influencing and aligning cross-functional teams (Sales, Brand, Partnerships, RevOps)

  • Data-driven: Confident in using data and insights to optimise performance and communicate impact

  • Agency management: Experience managing and scaling external agency relationships

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders

  • Tools: Familiarity with Salesforce, marketing automation platforms (SFMC/HubSpot), analytics and attribution tools

  • Mindset: Self-starter with strong ownership, adaptability, and curiosity to test and learn in a fast-paced environment

At Planday, we offer you

  • Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

  • On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

  • Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

  • Flexible remote work

  • Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

  • Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

  • Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

 

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture, and we highly value the strength that diverse backgrounds offer.

About our team:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

As a Senior/Principal Product Manager - Storage, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of Radiant’s cloud storage portfolio, spanning the storage services and data capabilities required to run demanding cloud and AI workloads at scale.

You’ll work across object, block, and file storage, data lifecycle, performance, resilience, APIs, and platform integrations, partnering closely with engineering, infrastructure, SRE, networking, security, commercial teams, and customers.

  • Define product requirements across object, block, and file storage, as well as the integration with the existing Radiant services.

  • Work with customers and internal teams to understand workload requirements around capacity, throughput, latency, resilience, and cost.

  • Drive integrations with compute, Kubernetes, IAM, observability, and developer tooling.

  • Own prioritisation, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous iteration.

  • Strong technical fluency across:

    • Storage: object, block, file, snapshots, replication, caching

    • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, containers, networking, cloud platforms

    • Reliability: durability, availability, consistency, failure recovery

    • Observability & security: metrics, logging, IAM, encryption, auditability

  • Familiarity with technologies such as Weka, Vast, DDN, MinIO, Lustre, Pure Storage, or similar.

  • Able to reason about trade-offs between performance, durability, availability, cost, and operational complexity.

  • Strong prioritisation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfortable working closely with engineers and customers on highly technical problems.

What you bring:

  • Storage domain knowledge: Understand how storage architecture impacts application and workload performance.

  • Product thinking: Turn complex infrastructure into simple, consumable services.

  • Technical fluency: Work credibly across storage, networking, compute, APIs, and distributed systems.

  • Customer empathy: Understand the needs of developers, platform teams, and infrastructure-heavy customers.

  • Ownership: Drive products from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

Our investors in Blackbird Ventures (Canva, CultureAmp etc.), Square Peg, Octopus Ventures, Icehouse, Peter Beck (Rocket Lab), Akshay Kothari (Notion Co-Founder) and Dylan Field (Figma Co-Founder).

Own the rollout of Repair AI

  • Own the rollout of our flagship agentic capability, across your groups. You are the person who takes it from a handful of sites to the way these businesses work.

  • Run the pilots and prove the case with the customer's own data: hours out of the parts process, margin won, jobs touched. Then get it out of the pilot site and across the group

  • Find the next job worth giving to an agent. You will sit closer to how a bodyshop actually runs than anyone else at Partly, and most of that day is still manual. Come back with where the next one is and the evidence for it

  • Feed what breaks straight to product, in detail, so Repair AI is built against real shops rather than assumptions

Own the commercials on your accounts

  • Carry the commercial relationship: rates, rollout commitments, renewals and the terms that come with them

  • Structure deals so both sides win when adoption rises, and hold groups to what they committed to

  • Escalate to the Sales Director when a group's economics do not fit the standard shape, with a proposal rather than a problem

Build the playbook

  • Work out what makes a group go from signed to ordering, and what makes one stall. The pattern is not written down anywhere today

  • Prove it on your own book first, then turn it into something repeatable: the rollout sequence, the pilot, the proof, the conversation that changes how a site buys

  • Make it survive you. The measure is whether the next person can pick it up and get the same result, not whether you personally carried the number

  • Write it so the next hire can pick it up and get the same result. If you do, this seat becomes a team and you have a claim on leading it

 

🥷 Your skills

 

  • You've taken an early product into an existing customer base, where the pitch is not finished and the first pilots decide whether it lands

  • Can design the playbook, not just run one. There is no template for this seat and no ramp to inherit. You will work out what actually moves a signed group from live to ordering, prove it on your own accounts, and write it down so the next person can run it

  • You have carried and hit a number on existing accounts, through adoption and expansion rather than new logos alone

  • Commercially credible and self sufficient with account data. You can diagnose an account and build your own views rather than waiting for someone to build them

  • Comfortable where the playbook is still being written, and happy to write it

  • Willing to get into the market. Our customers are bodyshops and the job does not work from a desk

  • (Bonus) Automotive aftermarket, collision repair or parts distribution background, or having sold a product where usage rather than signature is the paid event

Please note: if you don't have all the skills or experience listed above but believe you could be outstanding in this role, please still consider applying. Many people count themselves out. We'd love the chance to learn more about you and why you're exceptional.

 

🎁 Benefits

  • Healthy, Catered Lunches - Enjoy fresh, healthy lunches every workday in our Auckland, Christchurch, London, and Austin offices. With no meal prep needed, you can eat, connect, and refuel with your team. (And yes, snacks and drinks are always on hand.)

  • Healthy Body, Healthy Mind - We care about performing at our peak. Every team member gets a $1,500 annual wellness allowance (or local equivalent) on a Partly-branded card. Use it on things such as gym memberships, rock climbing, physical therapy, massage, doctor visits, prescriptions—anything that you or your family need!

  • Family Comes First - Primary caregivers receive 3 months of fully paid parental leave, plus a flexible return-to-work plan (four days a week at full pay for your first three months back).

  • Workspaces That Inspire - Our brand-new, architecturally designed offices are built for collaboration and creativity, with great coffee, social spaces, and some of the best cafes just a few steps away.

  • Getting Here Is On Us - If you commute to a Partly office or coworking space (atleast 4 days a week), choose from a paid 24/7 parking spot or a commuting allowance. One less thing to think about!

  • Office-First with Flexibility - In cities where we have an office (Christchurch, Auckland, London, and Austin), we default to working from the office every day. This lets us move faster, make better decisions, and build strong relationships. We also operate with a high-trust environment, so you can manage your time around your life and flex your schedule to do your best work.

  • Time Off - you can use your annual leave and sick leave from day one, no waiting to accrue it first. And if you ever go into a negative balance, that's fine too, we trust you to manage your own time off

  • We Celebrate Together - From weekly happy hours and monthly lunches to quarterly season openers and an annual global offsite, we make time to connect, celebrate, and have fun as one team.

  • Giving - We support charitable giving and will top up your donation by 33% for charities on the GiveWell list

  • Equity - You'll receive share options (ESOP) with a 4-year vesting schedule and a 1-year cliff, true ownership in Partly from day one. Your strike price is a flat $0.01 per share, and you have up to 10 years to exercise.

     

🛬 Relocation

If you're relocating to Partly HQ, whether from overseas or within the country, we offer a generous relocation allowance to help support your move.

jobs.title: Director, Venture Cafe London
jobs.description:
Are you a natural leader with a strong network, driven to tackle your city's biggest challenges and connect diverse groups to make things happen? If so, you belong at Venture Café!


At Venture Café, we aim to create a global community of innovators with equal access to resources and opportunities, addressing our most pressing challenges. Ready to make an impact with us?


The Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI) seeks a strategic, dynamic, and self-driven Director to lead Venture Café London in the heart of the Knowledge Quarter. This is a unique opportunity to operate and grow a hub for Deeptech innovation and connection, in close collaboration with ARIA.


ABOUT VENTURE CAFÉ

Venture Café believes that Isolation is the enemy of innovation and our mission is clear: Connect innovators to make things happen. We are a neutral and trusted center of gravity that connects the entire innovation ecosystem and is available for everyone. 


Our flagship program, the Thursday Gathering, is a dynamic and intentionally designed experience freely accessible to all. Featuring vibrant networking sessions activated with captivating demos or immersion in the night’s theme by attending thought-provoking sessions led by inspiring speakers. Here, curiosity meets opportunity, connections flourish, and innovation thrives.


Venture Café was founded by Tim Rowe, founder and CEO of the Cambridge Innovation Center (CIC), in 2009 and helped fuel the growth of one of the world’s most powerful innovation ecosystems: Boston’s Kendall Square. What began with a modest gathering of 12 people at our inaugural Thursday Gathering has flourished into the Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI). Over the past 15 years, VCGI has united over 900,000 visionaries, developers, creatives, and civic leaders across 24cities worldwide, building a global community of communities.


At VCGI, we believe if we’re going to solve humankind’s biggest challenges, we need as many amazing humans as possible involved in that process.


YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK

Reporting to the Head of UK, Venture Cafe United Kingdom, you will lead the established Venture Café London team, directing programming for the Thursday Gathering and other ecosystem-building activities. Your goal is to ensure Venture Café programming continues to connect local innovators to the national and international entrepreneurship community.


Your role would be to execute weekly Venture Café Thursday Gatherings including the following:


• Collaborating closely with VCGI and ARIA to continue to successfully implement and refine the strategy for Venture Café London.

• Scoping and securing financial partners for Venture Café London and building a pipeline for funding opportunities.

• Working closely with the Head of UK and the other UK Directors to ensure success and align initiatives where appropriate.

• Scoping and developing a rolling programming strategy to inspire and connect the local innovation community.

• Collaborate with the ARIA team and Programme Directors to drive value to the ARIA Opportunity Spaces.

• Identifying and partnering with local ecosystem leaders as an advocate and spokesperson to build diverse and inclusive programs.

• Developing innovative program formats for delivering content and creating connection opportunities to maximize engagement.

• Leading and overseeing strategic planning, impact measurement and program budget for Venture Café in London.

• Attracting sponsorship for programs and aligning them within the Thursday Gathering framework.

• Leading and coaching your three direct reports towards success.

• Continuously reviewing and implementing improvements/changes to ensure the ongoing success and reputation of Venture Café London.

• Collaborating with the Venture Café global network and ARIA to connect the London community to global opportunities.

• Identifying and mitigating risks to the effective operation of the Thursday Gathering.

• Nurturing existing initiatives to support Venture Café’s Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB) efforts, while bringing a visionary approach to developing and expanding DEIB-driven programming and partnership opportunities.



ABOUT YOU

You understand your city’s challenges and see them as opportunities, combining a fascination with trends and a humanistic perspective. Passionate about mission-driven work, you'll lead Venture Café London by nurturing relationships, leading teams, and thriving in ambiguity. Your skills include leading programs, matchmaking, innovating, connecting with the community, and fostering collaboration. You are comfortable with public speaking, have excellent communication skills, and excel at connecting across business, academia, government, and civil society. You bring a global outlook with local roots and a strong community commitment. 


​​More specifically, you thrive in:


• Leading people and complex programs.

• Being a match-maker extraordinaire and seeing opportunities at the intersections of people, ideas & resources.

• Envisioning, developing and implementing innovative program experiences.

• Connecting with a broad cross-section of the community. 

• Bringing people together to collaborate towards a common goal.

• Identifying and developing mutually beneficial partnerships.


Additionally, you have:

• Knowledge of London’s  startup community, key influencers, networks and organizations.

• Excellent organizational, project, and task management skills.

• Experience securing funding opportunities and a network of potential funders. 

Familiarity with digital media channels. An ability to leverage them as part of your work.

• Comfort in Google Suite, email campaign software, and project management software.

• Availability to work in our London office Tuesday, Wednesday and on Thursday until 9pm

• Fluency in English.

• Ability to legally work in the UK. We are unable to sponsor visas for this role at this time.


OUR OFFER

• Employment contract.

• Competitive compensation based on experience


Venture Café welcomes all candidates regardless of race, color, ancestry, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status or disability. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Samverka med organisationens interna servicecenter

En trygg anställning genom kollektivavtal och försäkringar.

Initiativtagande & drivkraft

    

Flexibilitet & anpassningsförmåga

    

Samarbetsförmåga & laganda

    

Engagemang & uthållighet

    

Struktur & ansvarskänsla

    

God Kommunikationsförmåga & pedagogik

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free and told a colleague. The market is open and the clinicians in it already like the product. Your job is to turn those smaller scale use cases into enterprise deals.

You're the first line to Heidi in DACH. Inbound demand connects you with practices, MVZs and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out or close it yourself. Where the signals run thin, you build the outbound.

For most clinicians you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. You'll both triage inbound to your Account Executive where it belongs and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across German-speaking healthcare that outlasts the role.

What you’ll do

  • Work the inbound queue and the warm product signals across DACH. Your day goes to clinicians and practices already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version.

  • Build outbound where the signals are thin: pick the practice groups, MVZs and hospital groups worth going after and work them in German.

  • Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the practice or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the angle for each one.

  • Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh.

  • Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff.

  • Own small SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month.

  • Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get, and so the German-language product and collateral keep up with what you hear.

  • Track what's shifting in German healthcare (regulation, the practice groups, the insurers, the competitive set) and tell the team what you're hearing on the phones.

What we're looking for

  • Native or fluent German, and English that allows you to work in a global team.

  • You've worked somewhere with a high bar, whether that's tech, sales, creative, banking, consulting, or PE/VC. We care more about what you've achieved than any time in a sales role.

  • You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product works than memorise a pitch.

  • You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have extremely busy schedules, you respect that and still get the meeting.

  • Knowing how German healthcare buys (who decides in a Praxis, an MVZ or a hospital group, and who pays) is a head start. If you don't know it yet, you're the type who'd learn it in your first month.

  • Organised and self-running. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

 

Attitude is more important than experience so if you are a hungry, competitive and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem solving and building relationships we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

We’ve consolidated separate compliance programs (Grammarly, Coda, Superhuman Mail, and Superhuman Go) into a single program. We’re rapidly replacing the point-in-time approaches with continuous, automated, code-defined evidence, and this role continues to build on that.

The job is to automate your way out of the manual toil: our GRC automation platform is the evidence-automation backbone, agentic systems (Claude Code and similar) are the force multiplier, and GitHub is where the program lives as code. If your instinct on seeing a manual control-testing process is to turn it into a repeatable, automated pipeline, this role is for you.

What You Will Do:

  • Automate evidence collection. Configure and operate the GRC automation platform: wire up data sources, build evidence plugins, scope data sets, author analysis rules, and stand up continuous monitoring operations, replacing screenshot-and-upload workflows with automated collectors mapped to controls.

  • Automate GRC workflows and run compliance as code. Use Claude Code (or similar) and MCPs for evidence requests, control mapping, gap analysis, vendor reviews, and reporting; build and curate the team’s agent harness; and manage policies, control definitions, and automation in GitHub through branches, pull requests, and review.

  • Design control testing and drive remediation. Instrument testing across SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, and ISO 42001 for continuous assurance rather than point-in-time snapshots, and work with control owners and engineering to close gaps with automated evidence behind every finding.

What Ramping Up Looks Like:

You will be configuring our GRC automation platform, not just clicking through it, within your first few weeks. In your first 90 days, we’d expect you to learn the platform configuration, ship your first automated evidence collectors, retire a batch of manual screenshot evidence, and get at least one agent-assisted workflow running end-to-end.

Why This Role:

  • You’ll design the automation architecture for compliance across four products, rather than maintaining an existing checklist.

  • You get the mandate and the tooling to retire manual evidence collection: a GRC automation platform, agentic AI, and compliance-as-code.

  • We actually run LLMs and AI agents in production GRC workflows today. This is how the team operates day-to-day.

  • Small team, high ownership, and a direct line to Legal and Engineering leadership. You’ll shape the program, not just sustain it.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in compliance, GRC, or IT audit, hands-on with the frameworks above (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and adjacent).

  • 1+ year using agentic AI systems (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to do real compliance work, with automation you have delivered, not just prototypes.

  • Comfortable in GitHub: repos, branches, pull requests, and code review. CI/CD familiarity is a strong plus.

  • Fast on new tooling. You can pick up a GRC automation platform and be productive in weeks, configuring it directly rather than relying on others to do so.

  • Deep GRC fluency: control design, evidence, risk, and how auditors actually think.

  • Working knowledge of cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP): IAM, compute, storage, networking, and security controls, because that’s where the evidence lives.

  • Systems thinker who prefers to automate repetitive manual work rather than repeat it.

Nice to Have:

  • Reads APIs, JSON, and logs comfortably; scripting (Python, bash, TypeScript).

  • Prior hands-on experience with a GRC automation platform (Vanta, Drata, or similar).

  • Scripting/light coding and API integration experience.

  • Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or similar.

  • AI governance, AI risk management, or ISO 42001 exposure.

  • Background in a technology, SaaS, or engineering-adjacent environment.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

     

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

Deine Rolle

Als Quantitative Investment Analyst (d/m/w) bist du Teil unseres Investmentteams und arbeitest an der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Steuerung unserer Anlagestrategien über Public und Private Markets hinweg mit. Die Position ist ab November 2026 zu besetzen.

Was machst du konkret?

  • Daten: Du verantwortest alle strategiebezogenen Daten sowie deren Pflege in unseren Systemen. Dazu gehört insbesondere der Aufbau einer robusten technischen Infrastruktur zur Aggregation, Überwachung und Darstellung von Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen, darunter Bloomberg, Morningstar und unser Data Warehouse.

  • Weiterentwicklung der Code Base: Du entwickelst und verbesserst unsere Code Base. Dazu gehören unter anderem Python-basierte Tools für Portfoliosimulationen, Backtesting und Fondsauswahl.

  • Asset-Allocation-Modelle: Du unterstützt die quantitative Research-Arbeit hinter unseren Asset-Allocation-Modellen, indem du eigenständig Modellerweiterungen backtestest, neue Signale evaluierst und Analysen für unsere Investmententscheidungen vorbereitest.

  • Kapitalmarktanalysen: Du führst eigenständig quantitative Kapitalmarktanalysen durch und unterstützt damit unsere Analyst sowie unsere Client Advisors.

Das bringst du mit

  • Hintergrund: Du hast einen Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance, Informatik, Physik oder einem verwandten Fachbereich und eine starke Affinität zu Daten. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrung in den Bereichen Kapitalmärkte, statistische Modellierung oder Datenanalyse gesammelt.

  • Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen: Du verfügst über sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten, arbeitest äußerst sorgfältig und detailorientiert und bringst eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Python und SQL und hast Erfahrung mit Google Cloud Services. Idealerweise hast du außerdem bereits mit investmentbezogenen Datenanbietern wie Bloomberg oder Morningstar gearbeitet. Darüber hinaus bringst du ein solides Verständnis der Kapitalmärkte mit.

  • Mindset: Dein ausgeprägter Blick fürs Detail geht Hand in Hand mit einer sorgfältigen und gewissenhaften Arbeitsweise. Ineffektive und ineffiziente Prozesse stören dich, und du gehst proaktiv an Verbesserungen heran. Du fühlst dich in einem anspruchsvollen, aber informellen Start-up-Umfeld wohl und überzeugst durch starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

  • Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

     

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 3,8 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

 

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

jobs.title: Regulatory Counsel - Malta
jobs.description:
At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about regulation, we’d love for you to join our team as a Regulatory Counsel. This is an exciting opportunity for a professional looking to make a significant impact in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Regulatory Counsel is a mid-level role within the Regulatory function, responsible for providing independent regulatory advice and analysis to the business across multiple gambling jurisdictions.

The Regulatory Counsel takes ownership of a defined portfolio of regulatory matters, providing clear and practical advice on the application of gambling laws, licence conditions, and regulatory requirements.

The role involves independent management of licensing and regulatory submissions, proactive identification of regulatory risks, and substantive input into the development of policies, frameworks, and business initiatives. The Regulatory Counsel will develop relationships with internal stakeholders and regulators, contributing meaningfully to the delivery of the team’s objectives.

Accountabilities:

Regulatory Advisory & Interpretation

    Monitor, analyse and interpret regulatory developments across multiple gambling jurisdictions, assessing their impact on the business.
    Provide clear, practical, and independent regulatory advice to internal stakeholders across product, marketing, payments, operations, and technology.
    Conduct substantive legal research and regulatory analysis on applicable laws, licence conditions, and regulatory frameworks.
    Manage regulatory queries from the business, providing timely and well-reasoned responses with limited supervision.
    Provide regulatory input on customer-facing terms and conditions, complaints, and related matters.
    Identify and escalate novel, complex, or high-risk regulatory issues to the Senior Regulatory Counsel as appropriate.

Regulatory Strategy & Business Enablement

    Lead regulatory impact assessments in connection with new products, features, market entries, and strategic initiatives.
    Identify, assess, and advise on regulatory risks, contributing to risk assessments and mitigation strategies.
    Drive cross-functional engagement to support the embedding of regulatory requirements across the business.
    Provide substantive regulatory guidance on AML/CFT, sanctions, responsible gambling, data protection, and other key regulatory areas.
    Support the Senior Regulatory Counsel in providing regulatory input into the business’s strategic planning and commercial activities.

Licensing & Regulatory Operations

    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Oversee and ensure compliance with regulatory reporting obligations, including timely and accurate submissions to licensing authorities.
    Maintain and develop regulatory registers, licences, approvals, and associated documentation.
    Manage and develop relationships with regulators and competent authorities, escalating significant regulatory interactions to the Senior Regulatory Counsel.
    Prepare and coordinate responses to regulatory inquiries, inspections, enforcement actions, and information requests.

Regulatory Framework & Policy Development

    Assist in the development and maintenance of assigned regulatory policies, standards, and frameworks, ensuring alignment with applicable laws and licence conditions.
    Provide substantive regulatory input into AML, responsible gambling, consumer protection, and other regulatory policy areas.
    Develop and deliver regulatory training and awareness materials to Compliance and operational teams.
    Identify gaps in existing policies and frameworks and propose improvements proactively.

Governance, Assurance & Collaboration

    Provide meaningful regulatory input into compliance monitoring activities, internal reviews, and audit processes.
    Collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Technology, and operational teams to ensure consistent interpretation and application of regulatory requirements across the business.
    Lead or contribute to regulatory workstreams within internal projects, change program, and cross-functional initiatives.
    Support junior members of the Regulatory team, providing guidance and reviewing their work where required.

Documentation & General

    Maintain accurate and up-to-date regulatory documentation, records, and internal registers.
    Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Regulatory function’s processes and ways of working.
    Perform other duties reasonably aligned with the role.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    3–4 years post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, ideally within iGaming, fintech, financial services, or other regulated industries.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Exposure to AML/CFT, responsible gambling, and consumer protection regulatory requirements is required.
    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language (Danish, Finnish, or Swedish) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Confident and credible in providing independent regulatory advice, with the judgement to know when to escalate.
    Commercially aware and solution-oriented, with a pragmatic approach to regulatory challenges.
    Proactive, intellectually curious, and committed to developing deep expertise in international gambling regulation.
    Collaborative and effective in building relationships with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary

    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Vad gör en mötesbokare hos oss?

    snabbt skapa förtroende och intresse,

    presentera varför ett möte med oss är värdefullt,

    följa upp tidigare kontakter,
    arbeta strukturerat i CRM,
    nå tydliga dagliga och månatliga mål.

Det handlar alltså inte om att fylla en kalender med vilka möten som helst.

Bra mötesbokning skapar affärer.

Vi letar mer efter personlighet än CV

Du behöver inte ha arbetat med brandskydd tidigare. Det lär vi dig.

Du behöver inte heller vara en färdig mötesbokare.

    lätt för att prata med människor,
    energi i telefonen,
    förmåga att lyssna,
    envishet utan att bli tjatig,
    förmåga att snabbt komma tillbaka efter ett nej,
    tävlingsinstinkt,
    disciplin nog att göra nästa samtal även när det föregående gick dåligt.

Har du arbetat med mötesbokning, telefonförsäljning eller kundkontakt tidigare är det meriterande.

Du får verktygen

Vi ger dig introduktion, produktutbildning, manus och struktur, löpande träning och coaching samt tydlig återkoppling på dina resultat.

Målet är inte att du ska läsa ett manus som en robot.

Målet är att du ska förstå kunden, bli bra på samtalet och kunna skapa ett möte som både kunden och vår säljare vill genomföra.

Vi erbjuder

Fast grundlön + prestationsbaserad ersättning.

Du får dessutom tydliga mål, utbildning och coaching, ett team som byggs från grunden och möjlighet att utvecklas vidare inom försäljning.

För den som visar resultat och ambition finns naturliga vägar vidare till exempelvis innesäljare, senior mötesbokare eller teamledare.

Vi tänker växa

Det här är början på en betydligt större säljsatsning.

Vi söker därför inte bara någon som behöver ett jobb.

Vi söker människor som vill lära sig ett yrke, bli riktigt bra på det och vara med när laget växer.

jobs.title: Power Platform Specialist
jobs.description:
Brinner du för automation, AI och low-code? Till vår kund Ving söker vi nu en Power Platform Specialist!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Möjlighet att arbeta i framkanten av Microsoft-teknik
    En central roll där din expertis inom Power Platform möjliggör innovativa lösningar och stärker våra Citizen Developers
    Nära samarbete mellan de nordiska länderna
    Ett högt medarbetarengagemang
    Kollektivavtal, tjänstepension enligt ITP planen och trygghetsförsäkringar
    Reseförmåner.

”Vi är en arbetsplats med ett stort kunnande och en stark drivkraft att ständigt förbättra vår verksamhet. Som en del av Nordic Leisure Travel Group erbjuder vi en spännande och utvecklande miljö med möjlighet till en intern karriär. Vår arbetsglädje och vårt höga engagemang visar sig i vår årliga medarbetarundersökning – och vi är stolta över att vara en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas.” Mer information om kunden ges vid personlig kontakt.

Vem söker vi?

    Högskoleutbildning inom datavetenskap, teknik, matematik eller motsvarande kunskap genom arbetslivserfarenhet
    Minst 3 års erfarenhet av Microsoft Power Platform, inklusive Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI & Copilot Studio
    Praktisk tillämpning av Generativ AI, AI-assistenter och AI-agenter
    Utmärkta problemlösnings- och analytiska färdigheter
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

Det är meriterande om du även:

    Har erfarenhet av att arbeta i en DevOps-kultur och med verktyg som AzureDevOps och GitHub
    Är certifierad inom AI & Microsoft Power Platform.

Ditt arbetssätt präglas av nyfikenhet och en vilja att ständigt utvecklas. Du motiveras av att lära dig nya saker och ser förändring som en möjlighet snarare än ett hinder. Vi värdesätter samarbete och söker en person som trivs i en teamorienterad miljö. Du är prestigelös, lyhörd och engagerad i att hitta gemensamma lösningar tillsammans med dina kollegor. Att ta ansvar är en självklarhet för dig, även när oväntade situationer uppstår. Du ser utmaningar som en naturlig del av arbetet och hanterar dem med ett positivt och lösningsfokuserat förhållningssätt.

Vad innebär rollen?

    Utforma, utveckla och tillhandahålla lösningar i Microsoft Power Platform & Copilot Studio
    Samarbeta med verksamheten och andra intressenter för att förstå affärskrav och identifiera möjligheter för AI-lösningar
    Ta fram ett ramverk för AI-agenter och hjälpa till att identifiera och prioritera användningsfall där AI-agenter kan skapa störst affärs- och verksamhetsvärde
    Utveckla och underhålla Power Platform-infrastruktur och verktyg inklusive AI-komponenter
    Hålla dig uppdaterad om de senaste utvecklingarna inom Microsoft Power Platform
    Utbilda och stötta Citizen Developers i organisationen
    Kommunicera komplexa tekniska koncept till icke-tekniska intressenter.

Som Power Platform Specialist kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i att utforma, utveckla och driftsätta lösningar i Microsoft Power Platform för att möta verksamhetens behov. Du kommer att ansvara för att driva plattformen framåt och att fungera som en möjliggörare för Citizen Developers inom vår organisation för low-code lösningar. Dessutom kommer du att arbeta i framkanten av teknologin genom att integrera Generativ AI, AI-assistenter och AI-agenter för att automatisera processer och skapa nya värden för verksamheten.

Du kommer att ingå i Vings Workplace team som ansvarar för att leverera innovativa och effektiva lösningar som driver vår verksamhet framåt. Teamet strävar efter att ständigt förbättras, och du kommer att ges stora möjligheter till personlig utveckling och att vara i framkant av den snabbt utvecklande low-code & AI teknologin.

jobs.title: Projektledare till bolag inom byggbranschen
jobs.description:
Är du en erfaren projektledare eller samordnare som vill vara med och leda spännande byggprojekt i framkant? Vi söker nu en engagerad person som vill växa med ett företag i en expansiv fas. I rollen kommer du att arbeta med både projektledning och samordning, beroende på projektens omfattning och behov. Här får du möjlighet att vara en nyckelspelare i utvecklingen av byggprojekt i södra Stockholm och skapa långvariga framgångar tillsammans med ett engagerat team.

Vad erbjuder vi?

·       Utvecklingsmöjligheter i ett växande företag

·       Engagerade ledare som prioriterar medarbetarnas utveckling

·       Ett företag i framkant inom byggbranschen

·       En värdegrund där alla anställda blir sedda och värderade för sina kunskaper.

Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att bli en del av ett företag som befinner sig i en spännande tillväxtfas. Här får du chansen att utvecklas och växa tillsammans med bolaget, där du kommer att vara en nyckelperson i ett företag som driver många intressanta och utmanande projekt i södra Stockholm.

Företaget är beläget i Rönninge, men ditt arbete kommer huvudsakligen att ske ute på projekten i södra Stockholm, med möjlighet till arbete på andra orter vid behov. Mer information om företaget och dess verksamhet ges vid personlig kontakt.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har en bakgrund inom byggledning, projektledning eller samordning och som har erfarenhet av att driva komplexa bygg- och industriprojekt. Du har god förståelse för entreprenadjuridik och är van att leda projekt genom samtliga skeden, från planering och projektering till genomförande, överlämning och uppföljning.

Vi ser gärna att du har arbetat i projekt med höga tekniska krav, många gränssnitt och flera involverade entreprenörer, exempelvis inom läkemedelsindustri, processindustri, renrum, datacenter eller annan avancerad industribyggnation.



Krav och kvalifikationer

·   Minst 5 års erfarenhet av projektledning, projektsamordning eller motsvarande ledande roll inom bygg- eller industriprojekt.

·   Dokumenterad erfarenhet av komplexa industri- eller tekniktunga byggprojekt.

·   Erfarenhet av att implementera och följa upp KMA (Kvalitet, Miljö och Arbetsmiljö).

·   God kunskap om entreprenadjuridik och kontraktshantering.

·   Högskole-/universitetsutbildning inom bygg, teknik, ekonomi eller annat relevant område.

·   Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Meriterande

·   Erfarenhet från projekt inom läkemedelsindustri, renrum, processanläggningar, datacenter eller annan tekniskt avancerad industrimiljö.

·   BAS-P/BAS-U.

·   Certifieringar såsom PMP, PRINCE2, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 eller motsvarande.

Vi söker dig som är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och har förmåga att skapa struktur i komplexa projektmiljöer. Du trivs med att samordna många aktörer och hantera flera parallella arbetsströmmar samtidigt som du behåller fokus på projektets mål, tidplan och ekonomi. Med ditt affärsmässiga förhållningssätt, din kommunikativa förmåga och ditt ledarskap skapar du förtroende hos både kunder, samarbetspartners och projektteam. Du har en stark drivkraft att utveckla projekt och människor, och motiveras av att leverera framgångsrika resultat i tekniskt krävande miljöer.

Vad innebär rollen?

Som Projektledare kommer du att leda och ansvara för projekt från start till slut, säkerställa att projekten håller budget, tidsramar och kvalitet enligt avtalade villkor. Du kommer att kommunicera med interna och externa intressenter, inklusive hantering av avtal och juridiska frågor. Med arbetsuppgifter som exempelvis inkluderar:

·       Skapa projektplaner, tidslinjer och budgetar

·       Säkerställa att KMA-krav, kalkylunderlag och juridiska aspekter inkluderas i projektets planeringsfas

·       Hantera och tolka entreprenadavtal samt säkerställa att projekten bedrivs enligt avtalsvillkor

·       Implementera och följa upp företagets KMA-policy i alla projekt

·       Fungera som kontaktpunkt mellan olika funktioner och externa parter

Detta är en rekrytering med start omgående. Denna rekryteringsprocess innehåller bakgrundskontroll som sammanställer tidigare offentligt brottsregister. Bakgrundskontrollen består av offentlig information som hanteras konfidentiellt samt en säkerhetskontroll där ekonomisk stabilitet är ett krav samt alkohol- och drogtest. Intresserad? Skicka in din ansökan snarast, tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Om 2Complete

Trygghet och förtroende är målen i 2Completes rekryteringsprocess. Detta uppnås genom ett nära och personligt samarbete med de kunder som valt oss som sin rekryteringspartner. Vår passion för att få ut människor i arbete och att få in rätt person i rätt sammanhang i arbetslivet, driver oss framåt.

jobs.title: Finance Specialist till Lynes i Solna
jobs.description:
Som Finance Specialist hos Lynes får du en bred och betydelsefull roll där ekonomi, affär och människor möts. Här får du stort eget ansvar, arbetar nära CFO och blir en viktig del av en verksamhet som ligger långt framme inom digitalisering, automatisering och AI.

Vad erbjuder vi?

    En bred och varierad roll inom ekonomi där du får arbeta med hela det löpande ekonomiflödet.
    Nära samarbete med CFO och insyn i flera delar av verksamheten.
    Möjlighet att påverka och utveckla ekonomirutiner och arbetssätt.
    En modern arbetsmiljö där automatisering och AI redan är en naturlig del av ekonomiarbetet.
    En roll med både självständigt ansvar och många kontaktytor internt och externt.

Lynes är ett företag med ett starkt fokus på digitalisering och smarta lösningar, där även ekonomiavdelningen arbetar aktivt med att förenkla och automatisera processer. I dagsläget finns exempelvis en AI-agent som analyserar och kontrollerar att bolaget har blivit korrekt fakturerat på hundratals avtal, samtidigt som AI används för att delvis automatisera arbetet med återförsäljarprovisioner. Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har en bred bakgrund inom ekonomi och redovisning och som är trygg i att självständigt hantera det löpande ekonomiarbetet. Du har förståelse för hur bokföring, reskontra, lön, deklarationer, bokslut och rapportering hänger ihop och trivs samtidigt i en roll där du har återkommande kontakt med kunder och återförsäljare.

    Erfarenhet av kontoavstämningar samt kund- och leverantörsreskontra.

    Erfarenhet av löneadministration
    God vana av ekonomi- och lönesystem samt Excel

Som person är du noggrann, strukturerad och ansvarstagande. Du har lätt för att skapa ordning, hålla koll på deadlines och följa upp avvikelser tills de är lösta. Du är trygg i att arbeta självständigt men vet också när det är rätt läge att stämma av med CFO.

Du ser gärna möjligheter till förbättring och effektivisering och uppskattar att hitta smartare sätt att arbeta, exempelvis genom digitalisering, automatisering och AI.

Vad innebär rollen?

Som Finance Specialist hos Lynes får du en central roll i det dagliga ekonomiarbetet och blir en viktig del av verksamheten. Du arbetar nära CFO och får möjlighet att ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ekonomiflödet fungerar korrekt och effektivt, från löpande bokföring och reskontra till bokslut, rapportering och löneadministration. Med arbetsuppgifter som exempelvis inkluderar:

jobs.title: OPERATIV CHEF / VICE VD
jobs.description:
OPERATIV CHEF / VICE VD – TILLVÄXTBOLAG I SOLNA

Vill du vara med och bygga ett bolag – inte bara förvalta ett?

Brand & Utrymningskontroll befinner sig i en kraftig expansionsfas.

Vi växer inom brandskydd, digitalt SBA, utbildning och säkerhet. Vi bygger samtidigt ut vår försäljningsorganisation, serviceverksamhet och våra digitala tjänster och förbereder fortsatt geografisk expansion.

Nu söker vi en operativ chef / vice VD som kan ta ett övergripande ansvar för den dagliga verksamheten och tillsammans med ägare/VD bygga nästa fas av bolaget.

Det här är inte en roll för dig som vill komma till en färdig organisation och förvalta den.

Du kommer hit för att bygga den.

Uppdraget

Ägare/VD driver idag både bolagets strategiska utveckling och en alltför stor del av den operativa verksamheten.

Det ska förändras.

Din uppgift blir att successivt ta över ansvaret för den dagliga driften och se till att organisationen levererar.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    leda och följa upp den operativa verksamheten
    styra och utveckla vår utesäljsorganisation
    följa försäljning, aktivitet, pipeline och resultat
    säkerställa att försäljning, administration, service, montage, utbildning och digital utveckling arbetar tillsammans
    leda chefer och nyckelpersoner i organisationen
    genomföra regelbundna resultat- och verksamhetsmöten
    säkerställa bemanning och rekrytering när organisationen växer
    identifiera flaskhalsar och lösa dem innan de blir problem
    arbeta med budget, nyckeltal och lönsamhetsuppföljning
    skapa struktur utan att göra organisationen långsam
    omsätta VD:s och styrelsens beslut till faktisk verksamhet

Du ska veta vad som händer i bolaget – utan att själv behöva göra allt.

Försäljning är en central del

Vi bygger nu en större försäljningsorganisation med både inne- och utesäljare.

Du behöver därför vara kommersiellt stark.

Du behöver inte vara företagets bästa säljare, men du ska kunna leda säljare, förstå deras siffror, ställa krav och se skillnaden mellan hög aktivitet och verkligt resultat.

Vi vill att du ska kunna titta på gårdagens kundbesök, offerter, avslut och försäljning och snabbt förstå:

Vad fungerar? Vad fungerar inte? Vad gör vi åt det idag?

Vem söker vi?

Vi tror att du tidigare har haft ett tydligt operativt ledningsansvar i ett ägarlett företag, tillväxtbolag eller annan entreprenöriell verksamhet.

Titeln du haft är mindre viktig.

Du kan idag exempelvis vara COO, operativ chef, affärsområdeschef, regionchef, försäljningschef eller VD i ett mindre bolag.

Det viktiga är vad du faktiskt har åstadkommit.

Vi vill därför gärna träffa dig som kan visa att du tidigare har:

    lett människor och chefer
    byggt eller skalat en organisation
    arbetat nära försäljning och resultat
    rekryterat och utvecklat personal
    skapat struktur i en verksamhet under förändring
    haft budget- och resultatansvar
    fattat beslut och fått dem genomförda

Vi söker en person med tempo, affärssinne och naturligt ledarskap.

Prestige är däremot ointressant.

När något behöver lösas förväntar vi oss att du löser det.

Du får ett stort mandat

Det här är en nyckelroll.

Vår ambition är att den operativa chefen successivt ska få ett mycket stort mandat över den löpande verksamheten.

Ägare/VD kommer i stället att koncentrera sig allt mer på strategi, affärsutveckling, nya affärsområden, förvärv, större affärer, leverantörer och geografisk expansion.

För rätt person finns en tydlig möjlighet att på sikt ta över rollen som VD.

Vi tänker oss att den utvecklingen kan bli aktuell inom ungefär 6–12 månader, men det avgörs av resultat, förtroende och hur samarbetet fungerar.

Vi erbjuder

En ovanligt central position i ett bolag där mycket händer.

Du får möjlighet att påverka organisation, arbetssätt och fortsatt expansion på riktigt.

Vi sitter i Solna och verksamheten bedrivs med högt tempo, korta beslutsvägar och stora ambitioner.

Tjänsten omfattar fast lön samt en attraktiv resultatbaserad bonusmodell kopplad till verksamhetens utveckling och uppnådda mål.

För rätt person finns en tydlig möjlighet att successivt få ett ännu större ansvar och på sikt ta över rollen som VD.

Ange löneanspråk i din ansökan.

När du söker

Vi är mindre intresserade av ett långt personligt brev och mer intresserade av vad du faktiskt har byggt och åstadkommit.

Besvara därför gärna följande:

1. Hur stor organisation har du haft ansvar för?

2. Vilket budget- eller resultatansvar har du haft?

3. Har du lett en försäljningsorganisation? Beskriv kort.

4. Berätta om en verksamhet du har byggt, förändrat eller skalat.

5. Vilket konkret resultat skapade du?

6. Hur arbetar du med chefer och medarbetare som inte når sina mål?

7. Vad har du för löneanspråk?

8. När kan du börja?

En sista sak

Vi söker inte en person som behöver få varje beslut förankrat uppåt.

Vi söker någon som efter att riktningen är beslutad kan säga:

”Jag tar det här.”

Och sedan göra det.
