jobs.title: Underviser i robotteknologi til Absalons ingeniør-uddannelser - genopslag
jobs.description:
Click for version in English

Vil du være med til at opbygge en ny engelsksproget diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi? Brænder du for at udvikle en ny uddannelse i tæt samarbejde med dygtige og engagerede kolleger, studerende og lokale virksomheder? Så kan det være dig, vi står og mangler til vores studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved efter- og videreuddannelsen i Automation og Drift.

På Absalon får du mulighed for at kombinere din erfaring fra robot-, automations- eller maskinområdet med undervisning. Samtidig sætter du dit faglige aftryk på uddannelsens indhold, laboratorier og samarbejde med industrien.

Absalon etablerer i september 2027 en ny engelsksproget diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi. Uddannelsen har fokus på integration af robot- og automationsløsninger og en forståelse for helheden i det produktionssystem, hvor løsningen skal indgå. Diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi indgår i tæt sammenhæng med diplomingeniøruddannelsen i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelsen på akademiniveau i Automation og Drift.

På ingeniøruddannelserne er det vores ambition at uddanne de bedste ingeniører i Danmark. Vi målretter vores uddannelse til arbejdsmarkedet ved at samarbejde tæt med den danske automations-, maskin- og procesindustri samt virksomheder og andre aktører i Biotekbyen Kalundborg og i Campus Kalundborgsamarbejdet. Læs meget mere her. https://www.biotekbyen.dk/

Din profil
Vi søger en underviser, der brænder for at uddanne inden for grænseområdet mellem robotteknologi, automation, produktionsstyring og maskinteknologi. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i nedenstående:

Dygtig og motiverende underviser, der er engageret i de studerende. Du bidrager sammen med dine kolleger til at skabe et aktivt, fagligt og socialt studiemiljø. Det er vigtigt, at du kan bidrage positivt til den nære faglige relation, vi har mellem undervisere og studerende.

Medvirker til at få det faglige, det praktiske og samarbejdet til at fungere godt. Vi er mere end en arbejdsplads, og du skal ligesom os, være drevet af et stærkt kammeratskab og en fælles faglig interesse. Du sparrer med din kolleger omkring din undervisning, og sammen finder vi løsninger på praktiske opgaver.

Du har desuden nemt ved at indgå i dialog med virksomheder, både i forhold til muligheder for efter- og videreuddannelse og hvad angår samarbejde med studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne.

Du har lyst til at indgå i et arbejdsfællesskab og være med til at etablere en ny uddannelse. Vi opbygger og udvikler løbende vores ingeniøruddannelser, og meget skal gøres for første gang. Du får en central rolle i beskrivelsen og opbygningen af den nye uddannelse i robotteknologi og automation. Du skal bl.a. være med til at indrette og skaffe det rette udstyr til kommende robot- og automationslaboratorier.

Din ingeniørfaglighed kommer i spil når du skal undervise, vejlede og sparrer med kolleger inden for dele af følgende områder:
  • Integration og programmering af industrirobotter, f.eks. Universal robots, ABB, KUKA, FANUC
  • Industri 4.0
  • Siemens TIA-portal
  • Industrielle netværk
  • Vision-systemer og sensorteknologi
  • Sikkerhedssystemer og cyber security
  • CE-mærkning og gældende standarder for fagområdet
  • Integration af AI i robot- og automationsløsninger
  • PLC-, HMI- og SCADA-løsninger
  • CAD og 3D print

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har en baggrund som ingeniør, det kan f.eks. være robot-/automationsingeniør, produktionsingeniør, elektroingeniør, maskiningeniør eller lignende
  • har relevant erhvervserfaring inden for ingeniørfaget
  • kan undervise på engelsk og gerne også på dansk
  • gerne er lektorbedømt
  • har indsigt i industriens behov for ingeniørkompetencer inden for robot og automationsområdet. Det er ikke et krav, men vil det være en fordel.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som underviser på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved Automation og Drift har du en række forskellige opgaver i løbet af en arbejdsuge.

Opbygge en uddannelse. Du har interesse i at spille en central rolle i etablering af ny uddannelse inden for robotteknologi og eventuelt have en koordinerende rolle i beskrivelse af uddannelsen, udarbejdelse af studieordning, etablering af studenter-, og virksomhedsnetværk samt indkøb af udstyr og indretning af laboratorium. Har du erfaring med og interesse i enkelte administrative opgaver vil det være en fordel.

Undervise og projektvejlede studerende. Du skal primært undervise og vejlede vores studerende både teoretisk og laboratorie- og projektbaseret inden for dine fagområder. Du skal selv tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisningen. Du skal også være med til løbende at udvikle vores undervisning.

Undervise på efter- og videreuddannelse (EVU) og på grunduddannelse. Du skal undervise studerende på fuldtidsstudium såvel som kursister med et fuldtidsarbejde ved siden af deres uddannelse på EVU. Til undervisningen på EVU kan der også være opgaver med opsøgende kontakt til virksomheder og præsentation af uddannelsesudbud.

Fagligt samarbejde som en del af hverdagen. Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du sparrer og samarbejder med dine kolleger. Sammen sørger I f.eks. for at tilrettelægge gode undervisningsforløb, udvikle undervisningsmaterialer, og måske er der et arrangement tilknyttet centret, som skal stables på benene.

Undervisningen på de forskellige uddannelsesudbud vil fortrinsvis være på vores Campus Kalundborg, men på EVU-området kan der forekomme undervisning på Absalons campus i Roskilde. Du skal være forberedt på, at noget undervisning kan foregå i weekend eller på aftener.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver ansat i Centre for Engineering and Science, som driver uddannelserne Bioanalytiker, Radiograf, Diplomingeniør i bioteknologi, Diplomingeniør i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelserne Diplomuddannelse i bioteknologi, Procesteknologi og kemi, Akademiuddannelse i Automation og Drift samt Akademiuddannelse i Innovation, produkt og produktion.

Du bliver en del af et team med uddannelsesleder, adjunkter og lektorer. På vores ingeniøruddannelser i Kalundborg er vi ca. 20 ansatte undervisere. Vi arbejder på at skabe den bedste ingeniøruddannelse i tæt samarbejde med biotekindustrien i Nordvestsjælland, samt vores engagerede studerende. Vi værdsætter høj faglighed og løser opgaver, samt udfordringer i fællesskab, hvor vi alle er bevidste om vigtigheden af at bidrage til fællesskabet og til centrets samlede målsætning.

Vi holder til i nybygget campusbygning fra 2021 og i nabobygningen Helix Lab. Absalon er desuden med i Campus Kalundborginitiativet, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen med fem andre uddannelsesinstitutioner, og fra 2028 vil vi være en del af et nyt fælles Campus Kalundborg-byggeri.

Der kan blive tale om ansættelse som lektor Du bedes tilkendegive i din ansøgning, hvilken type ansættelse du søger.

Sådan ansøger du
Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 41.232,- kr. inkl. pension.For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.537,- kr. inkl. pension.Der er mulighed for at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027, meget gerne før
  • Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Jesper Stensbo Knudsen, jesk@pha.dk, 7248 3224
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger, eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 15. november 2026
  • Vi forventer at afholde samtaler løbende, dog senest i uge 47 og 48.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

For stillingen gælder det, at du ansættes som adjunkt eller lektor alt efter dine kvalifikationer.
På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og hvor alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Ved ansættelse af lektorer, der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2020/673

Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2021/1458

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Senior Interior Designer
jobs.description:
About the Zeekr brand Zeekr is Geely’s luxury EV brand and is committed to being a user-driven tech company. We create new ecosystems focused on innovation with users at the centre of operations. "We have a chance to define the values of the Zeekr brand first of all, and there are two statements that are important for its future: one is being human centric, and the other is about being technology driven. Both of these ideologies are pushing the design philosophy forward."- Stefan Sielaff, VP of Global Design, Geely Auto Group, Head of Zeekr Design & Head of Geely Design Center Gothenburg in Car Design News on Dec 12, 2022

About the team We are a fast-growing team of both creative and management professionals with the task of delivering exciting global products suitable for volume production and innovative concepts. In an inspiring studio environment, we build and maintain a top-class design team of multiple nationalities. With best-in-class processes and tools, we challenge preconceptions and deliver premium car design.

Are you passionate about shaping the future of automotive interiors? As a Senior Interior Designer, you'll have the opportunity to create innovative, user-centered interior experiences that combine cutting-edge design, craftsmanship, and technology. Working in a highly creative and international environment, you'll help transform ideas into production-ready designs that elevate the driving experience for customers around the world.

Key responsibilities:

    

Create inspiring interior design concepts from initial sketches through to production intent.

    

Develop and visualize innovative solutions using both digital and physical design tools.

    

Translate design ideas into high-quality 3D models and Class-A surfaces.

    

Collaborate closely with Color & Trim, CMF, engineering, and fabrication teams to deliver a unified design vision.

    

Present and communicate design concepts, rationale, and user benefits to stakeholders.

    

Work with suppliers to ensure high-quality execution while maintaining the intended design vision.

    

Support prototype development and validation activities when needed.

    

Drive projects independently while contributing to a collaborative design culture.

Your skills & experience

    

Degree in Transportation Design, Industrial Design, Product Design, or a related field.

    

6-10 years of experience in automotive interior design, preferably within a Chinese OEM environment.

    

Strong sketching, visualization, and storytelling abilities.

    

Proficiency in industry-standard design and visualization tools such as Alias, Blender, Maya, Houdini, Gravity Sketch, Grasshopper, and KeyShot.

    

Experience taking designs from concept development through surfacing and production feasibility.

    

Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and interior automotive trends.

    

Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; Mandarin is considered an advantage.

    

Structured, analytical, and able to balance creativity with technical and business requirements.

    

Self-driven, flexible, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment.

    

A collaborative team player who enjoys turning ambitious ideas into exceptional products.

Last Application date: 2026-10-18

Apply today, we will perform ongoing selection during the application period. We look forward to hearing from you.

Please note that due to GDPR regulations we can only accept applications and CV's sent through the recruitment system, not via email or other channels.

Working at ZEEKR Design

We are engineers, developers and innovators from around the world. Joined together by entrepreneurship, our unique blend of Chinese and Scandinavian culture and a belief in a smarter more sustainable future.

    

Supportive and creative work environment

    

30 days of vacation and additional 6 days paid ATK- days annually

    

Great office location at Lindholmen Science Park

jobs.title: Global Mental Health Researcher
jobs.description:
DIGNITY is looking for a Global Mental Health Researcher to join our International Programmes Department. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated, early-career researcher, who wants to generate new and impactful knowledge, strengthen mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) programming, and contribute to better outcomes for people affected by torture and other forms of violence and adversity.

DIGNITY is an international human rights and development organization with a significant research capacity that works to prevent torture and violence, rehabilitate survivors, and enable justice and accountability. Our International Programmes Department works closely with local civil society partners, researchers and public institutions in countries affected by conflict, violence and political repression. Research plays a central role in our work by fostering innovation and critical reflection and generating evidence that strengthens programmes, informs policy and contributes to improved practice and impact.

About the position

As Global Mental Health Researcher, you will join our newly established International Research and Learning Unit together with an interdisciplinary team of senior researchers and monitoring and evaluation experts and analysts. Your tasks will be i) to contribute to developing DIGNITY’s international research agenda on Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) and ii) to offer technical advice to our rehabilitation programmes. You will be working with DIGNITY’s senior researchers, project managers and technical experts and collaborate closely with our partners in Asia, Africa, MENA and Eastern Europe. As an early-career researcher, we expect you to take on and develop the following tasks and responsibilities with a strong commitment to learn and grow as a researcher and advisor at DIGNITY.

Primary responsibilities
  1. To develop and conduct MHPSS research with guidance from DIGNITY Senior Researchers
  2. To support ongoing research in collaboration with DIGNITY’s Senior Researchers
  3. To offer advise on development and evaluation of DIGNITY’s MHPSS projects and programming in low- and middle-income countries

Specific tasks include:

  • To develop and conduct research projects and contribute to the formulation of grant applications focused on mental health and well-being of populations affected by violence and other forms of adversity, in line with DIGNITY’s strategy and mandate
  • To support ongoing research through qualitative and quantitative data analysis, coauthoring manuscripts and reports, and collaboration on grant applications
  • To contribute to the strengthening of DIGNITY’s MHPSS research agenda, networks and profile
  • To produce peer reviewed publications and other impactful research outputs
  • To provide technical advising for MHPSS projects
  • To contribute to the capacity building to partners and public authorities in DIGNITY programme contexts
  • To provide programmatic input to project documents, funding applications, policy and advocacy
About you

You hold a PhD in Psychology, Public Health or another relevant interdisciplinary field.

In addition, we expect that you have:

  • Competencies and experiences in applied research
  • Abilities and interest in to translating technical expertise into actionable knowledge for non-experts
  • Familiarity with evidence-based manualized MHPSS(e.g. PM+)
  • Experience with quantitative and qualitative research methods
  • Basic understanding of project management methodologies and tools
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities, tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Good collaboration and communication skills and strong commitments to work in teams and to co-produce knowledge and learning
  • Ability to work in a multi-cultural environment
  • Experiences with and/or strong interests in trauma-informed approaches to vulnerable and at-risk populations
  • Experiences with and/or strong interests in intersectional, decolonial, rights-based and/or survivor-centred approaches an advantage
  • Proficiency in Arabic, French, Ukrainian or Russian is an advantage
We offer
  • A meaningful research position in an internationally recognised human rights and development organisation.
  • An opportunity to contribute to globally relevant research that improves the lives of torture survivors and other populations affected by violence.
  • A collaborative and highly professional international research environment.
  • Close collaboration with experienced researchers, programme colleagues and local partners across multiple countries.
  • Flexible working arrangements and a strong emphasis on work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, learning and professional development.
Terms of employment

The position is permanent and based in DIGNITY’s International Programmes Department in the International Research and Learning Unit with reference to the Head of International Research and Learning.

Your place of employment is Copenhagen at our HQ at Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Copenhagen Ø.

We expect you to have a civil registry address in Denmark during the full employment.

Expected entry is 1 February 2027.

Your working hours are 37 hours per week, with the expectation that additional work may take place. It will be possible to take time off after having additional working hours within our flexible work schedule.

The position includes approximately 40 days of international travel annually.

Salary and terms of employment will follow the applicable Danish collective agreement and will be based on qualifications and relevant experience. The salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 42.-47.000 (gross, monthly) + pension (18.07%).

More info

Further information regarding the position can be obtained by contacting Head of International Research and Learning Tomas Max Martin at tm@dignity.dk.

The position will be filled following an academic assessment. As part of the hiring process, the shortlisted candidates’ research qualifications will be assessed with focus on research publications, grants, academic paper presentations, convening of panels, academic networks, research dissemination and communication, real-world and policy impact.

An application consisting of:

  • A CV
  • a motivational letter
  • documentation of completed PhD degree
  • a complete publication list
  • three selected peer reviewed articles (for co-authored publications, applicants should briefly describe their own contribution to each of the three selected publications), and
  • a short academic portfolio (maximum three pages) describing the applicant's contribution to selected research projects and publications, methodological expertise, experience with research funding, international research collaboration and networks, research dissemination, teaching experience and examples of contributions to policy, practice or programming (with links to documents where appropriate).

should be submitted via the link no later than 25 October 2026.

Shortlisted candidates will be assessed in the first half of November, and all applicants will be notified whether their application has been accepted for assessment.

We expect to hold the first round of interviews in November 2026 (week 48) and the second round of interviews end of November/start December 2026 (week 49), and both will take place in Copenhagen.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: Privacy policy - DIGNITY - Danish Institute Against Torture.

DIGNITY is an international human rights and development organisation that has worked for a world free of torture and violence since 1982. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be prosecuted. You can read more about our organisation and work at www.dignity.dk. DIGNITY regards diversity as a strength and therefore encourages all qualified persons to apply for the position regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age.

jobs.title: Zorgcoördinator – Ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking
jobs.description:
Wij zoeken een ervaren zorgcoördinator voor de doelgroep ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking.

Wat ga je doen?

Je komt te werken in Clinge met de doelgroep ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking. Jouw toewijding als zorgcoördinator is bijzonder, jij biedt cliënten een fijn thuis, geborgenheid, structuur, stabiliteit en perspectief. Binnen deze doelgroep kan sprake zijn van moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag. Dit vraagt om een sensitieve, geduldige en professionele benadering, waarbij je samen met het team en gedragsdeskundige zoekt naar de betekenis en behoeften achter het gedrag. Je begeleidt cliënten vanuit een individueel begeleidingsprogramma. Hierbij is het opbouwen en borgen van een onvoorwaardelijke ondersteuningsrelatie essentieel.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteit van zorg. In samenwerking met de manager en gedragsdeskundige zet je de lijnen van het behandelklimaat uit. Je stemt met alle betrokkenen af hoe jullie de zorg het beste laten aansluiten. Samen met het team en betrokken netwerk, heb je een coachende rol in het leven van deze cliënten. Dit doe je vanuit de Triple -C methodiek.

Je bent als zorgcoördinator teamcoach van het team, waarbij je het team coacht op zorginhoudelijke aspecten en de teamdynamiek. Daarnaast werk je wekelijks mee in het rooster, samen met je team. Met jouw enthousiasme breng je je kennis en ervaring over op je collega’s.

Naast je rol binnen het team ben je onderdeel van een zorgcoördinatorteam. Samen met je collega’s werk je aan kwalitatief goede zorg binnen Tragel. Je neemt actief deel aan de overleggen, denkt mee over ontwikkelingen binnen het cluster en bent een betrokken sparringpartner voor je collega’s in de dagelijkse praktijk.

Wat kun je?

De ideale zorgcoördinator werkt vanuit de visie en een positieve houding met minstens 3 jaar ervaring. Dit doe je met een grote mate van zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid voor de totstandkoming, actualisatie en uitvoering van bijvoorbeeld het zorgplan. Hiervoor heb je een relevante opleiding gevolgd en/of relevante werkervaring opgedaan.

Daarnaast ben je taak- en resultaatgericht en durf je voorop te lopen. Je hebt een goed beeld van zorgvragen en de mogelijkheden van de cliënten. Daar maak je concrete afspraken over. Je hebt een actieve rol in projecten vanuit maatschappelijke betrokkenheid, en je werkt zowel intern als extern samen met diverse disciplines en cliëntvertegenwoordigers.

Tot slot ben je goed in plannen, organiseren en doelgericht werken. Dit doe je met jouw goede communicatie- en sociale vaardigheden. Je bent in staat om op een inspirerende wijze collega’s aan te zetten tot kwaliteitsverbeteringen van zorg en begeleiding van de cliënten en bij te dragen aan ontwikkelingen in het team.

Een A1- of A2-opleiding, bachelor/graduaat orthopedagogiek, of opvoeder jeugd- en gehandicaptenzorg past perfect.

jobs.title: Flexi medewerker snijmachine
jobs.description:
Wil jij op dinsdag aan de slag als flexi medewerker bij een familiale aardappelboerderij? 
Je ondersteunt het productieproces aan de snijmachine en zorgt dat alles vlot verloopt. Je werkt actief mee en hebt een belangrijk aandeel in het maken van frietjes.

Jouw taken op een rijtje:

  • Je voert aardappelen aan naar de snijmachine
  • Je stelt de snijmachine correct in
  • Je controleert de kwaliteit van de gesneden frietjes
  • Je stapelt de verpakte producten op een transpallet
  • Je zorgt voor orde en netheid aan je werkpost
  • Je werkt voornamelijk staand en aan één vaste machine
  • Je helpt mee voor een vlot en veilig verloop van de productie

Zie jij jezelf in deze job? Neem dan zeker contact op. We bekijken graag samen of dit iets voor jou is.

  • Je bent betrouwbaar en stipt
  • Je kan fysiek werk aan en werkt graag actief
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor kwaliteit
  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid aan de machine
  • Je bent bereid om de snijmachine aan te leren
  • Ervaring in productie is een pluspunt, geen vereiste
  • Je beschikt over minimum TSO werk- en denkniveau

jobs.title: Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

jobs.title: Lagermedarbejder søges til deltidsvikariat i Glostrup
jobs.description:
På vegne af en kunde i Glostrup søger FIRMAVIKAR en stabil og ansvarsbevidst lagermedarbejder til et deltidsvikariat med mulighed for flere timer og dage på sigt.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af den daglige drift på lageret og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med de øvrige medarbejdere.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Modtagelse af varer og forsendelser

  • Oprettelse af ordrer i Uniconta

  • Pluk, pak og klargøring af varer til forsendelse

  • Holde orden på lageret

  • Hjælpe med øvrige praktiske lageropgaver efter behov

Der kan forekomme løft på op til ca. 17 kg., så det er vigtigt, at du er indstillet på, at arbejdet også kan være fysisk.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra lager eller lignende arbejde

  • Er stabil og møder til tiden

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

  • Er struktureret og har sans for orden

  • Er fortrolig med IT og gerne har erfaring med Uniconta

  • Er klar til at hjælpe til, hvor der er behov

Arbejdstid

2–3 dage om ugen kl. 09.00–15.00.

Der vil være mulighed for flere arbejdsdage og flere timer på sigt.

Arbejdssted

Glostrup

Opstart

Hurtigst muligt.

Lyder det som noget for dig, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

jobs.title: Lekebergs Sparbank söker en Ekonomiadministratör
jobs.description:
Som ekonomiadministratör kommer du att arbeta brett med bankens ekonomi och administration och vara en del av administrationsavdelningen.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

    Dagliga avstämningar och ekonomiska rapporter
    Utredningsarbete och analyser
    Vara delaktig i månadsbokslut och löpande uppföljning
    Framtagande av rapporter och ekonomiska underlag för uppföljning och beslutsfattande
    Hjälpa till att rapportera till myndigheter och andra externa intressenter
    Delta i utveckling och förbättring av administrativa och ekonomiska processer

Om dig Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Du har lätt att skapa tillit och relationer med både medarbetare och våra samarbetspartners. Du är strukturerad, analytisk och noggrann och har en vilja att utvecklas och lära. Du trivs med att arbeta brett och självständigt samtidigt som du uppskattar samarbete med kollegor inom olika delar av verksamheten. Du har intresse för ekonomi, administration och är nyfiken på teknikens utveckling.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av ekonomiadministrativa arbetsuppgifter, exempelvis bokslut, uppföljning och analysarbete. Eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi är meriterande.

Hos oss får du chansen att utveckla dig själv i en varierad roll med stor insyn i verksamheten. Vår framgång bygger på att vi ställer upp för varandra – varje dag.

Enda banken med huvudkontor i Närke Lekebergs Sparbank grundades 1903. Banken har idag en affärsvolym på drygt 11 miljarder kronor, god lönsamhet och en mycket stark ställning inom vårt verksamhetsområde.

Vi är en sammanhållande länk i bygden och vi stödjer dess människor och deras individuella behov av att förstå, förenkla och utveckla sin ekonomi. Vår målsättning är att fortsätta vår framgångsrika utveckling som en självständig sparbank.

I dagsläget är vi 26 medarbetare, som alla har ambitionen att skapa en nära relation till våra kunder samt att ge dem förstklassig service.

På vår hemsida www.lekebergssparbank.se/kontakt hittar du mer information om vilka vi är och hur du når oss.

Ansökan med CV, referenser och personligt brev skickas till:

    E-post: jobb@lekebergssparbank.se
    Post: Lekebergs Sparbank, Att. Agneta Wiktorsson, Box 66, 716 21 Fjugesta

Skicka in din ansökan idag, då urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tillsättning av tjänsten kan ske före sista ansökningsdag.

Sista ansökningsdag är den 26 oktober 2026.

jobs.title: PhD student in Environmental Science, Department of Thematic Studies
jobs.description:
We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!

We are looking for a PhD student in Environmental Science to conduct qualitative, social science research on sustainable transitions in Swedish agriculture. The research focuses on how different stakeholders understand and communicate about sustainable financing, and how they collaboratively develop solutions in this area.

Your work assignments

As a PhD student, you will join a skilled, open and welcoming research group at Linköping University. Our researchers come from a range of backgrounds—including the social sciences, natural sciences and engineering—and we value diversity in experiences and perspectives. Together, we develop and apply innovative methods for environmental research, often in collaboration with other universities and a range of societal stakeholders.

The VERIFARM project, funded by Formas, is an interdisciplinary research project addressing the financing of and investment in the agricultural sector’s sustainable transformations. The project brings together expertise from the social and natural sciences within the broad field of environmental science, combined with industry knowledge from the banking sector and farmers’ professional expertise.

Your work will include investigating how different stakeholders understand, value and use information about the climate and biodiversity impacts of agriculture in relation to financing and investment. You will plan and conduct empirical studies, for example through interviews, focus groups, workshops and other dialogical and participatory methods. You will also carry out analysis as part of a larger interdisciplinary project team, in collaboration with farmers and representatives from the banking sector. The work will involve both collaborative and independent research.

The specific focus of your doctoral research will be developed within the overarching research questions of the project and in dialogue with the project team. The research questions, empirical material and methodological choices of your thesis will also be partly shaped by the knowledge, expertise and experience that you, as a PhD student, bring to the project. Depending on your background, your research may, for example, focus on sustainability reporting and ESG, financing and investment decisions, dialogue and collaboration between different stakeholders, or how environmental and sustainability information is generated, communicated and used in practice. Across these areas, the common focus is on how knowledge and dialogue can contribute to effective financing solutions for the agricultural sector’s climate transition and the promotion of biodiversity.

You will write scientific articles, present results at conferences, and participate in research education. As a PhD student you work on your thesis in the associated research project. Additional assignments such as teaching or other department tasks may be included up to a maximum of 20%.

Your qualifications

You have completed a degree at an advanced level, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which at least 60 higher education credits are at the advanced level, or otherwise acquired substantially equivalent knowledge. You meet the specific entry requirements if you demonstrate knowledge equivalent to 90 higher education credits (ECTS) in a subject of central importance to the field of Environmental Science. Relevant educational backgrounds for the advertised position include environmental science, environmental communication, business administration, or equivalent.

We are looking for someone who is motivated, curious and able to take responsibility for their own work, while also enjoying collaboration. Good command of both Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is required. As the position involves fieldwork, a valid category B driving licence is an advantage.

The following documented qualifications are required:

    Experience in data collection and analysis using qualitative research methods
    Knowledge of climate or sustainability transitions
    Strong scientific writing skills

The following documented qualifications are considered particularly advantageous:

    Experience with dialogical, co-creative and/or participatory methods, particularly focus groups or workshops, involving multiple types of stakeholders
    Knowledge of climate and/or sustainability transitions in agriculture
    Knowledge of biodiversity
    Knowledge of and/or experience with sustainability reporting, ESG, CSRD, corporate responsibility, or sustainability regulations
    Knowledge of financing, investment and the banking sector
    Experience of collaboration between academia and societal stakeholders
    Strong ability to communicate with people in international environments

Selection will be based on independent study projects or reports, certificates of professional experience, academic grades and interviews. In addition, the applicant should submit a preliminary outline of a potential doctoral research project within the framework described above (maximum 1 page). This outline will also form part of the basis for assessment, and applicants who are invited to an interview will be given the opportunity to further develop it.

The employment

When taking up the post, you will be admitted to the program for doctoral studies. More information about the doctoral studies at each faculty is available at https://liu.se/en/research/doctoral-studies

The employment has a duration of normally four years’ full-time equivalent. Extension of employment up to five years is based on the degree of departmental assignment. You will initially be employed for one year, after which your employment will be renewed.

Start date is January 2027/as soon as possible, based on agreement.

Salary and employment benefits

The salary of PhD students is determined according to a locally negotiated salary progression.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button below. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than November 2, 2026. Applications after this date wont be taken into consideration.

jobs.title: AI Trainers Network - English
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a AI Trainers Network - English based in France.

As part of a global AI contributor network, you will help shape smarter, safer, and more human-centered artificial intelligence through language and cultural expertise.
You will have the opportunity to work on flexible, remote projects involving AI training, annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation.
Projects can range from short assignments lasting a few days to longer engagements spanning several weeks, depending on business needs and your availability.
Your work may directly influence the quality, relevance, accuracy, and inclusiveness of advanced AI systems.
You will collaborate within a diverse international community while using digital tools to complete structured, detail-focused tasks.
Each project comes with clear information about the scope, timeline, requirements, and compensation, allowing you to choose opportunities that suit you.
This is an ideal opportunity for a curious, detail-oriented English speaker who wants to contribute to the future of AI while maintaining flexibility over when and where they work.


Accountabilities

  • Contribute to AI training projects by annotating or labeling text, images, audio, or other content according to detailed project guidelines.

  • Evaluate search results, advertisements, chatbot responses, or other AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and overall usefulness.

  • Create, review, and test prompts designed to improve the performance and reliability of large language models and other AI systems.

  • Assess content for linguistic, cultural, contextual, or industry-specific accuracy and help ensure AI outputs are appropriate for diverse audiences.

  • Follow project-specific instructions, quality standards, and evaluation criteria consistently while maintaining a high level of attention to detail.

  • Use digital platforms and online tools efficiently to complete assigned tasks, provide structured feedback, and meet project deadlines.

  • Adapt to different project scopes and levels of complexity, with assignments potentially ranging from short-term tasks to multi-week engagements.

jobs.title: Lead Portfolio Manager to Support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Nordic RCC is a fast-developing company providing regional power system planning data and security analysis to support the national Transmission System Operators of Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark - to ensure the efficient operation of the Nordic Power System and high security of power supply at any time, with a vision of green transition.

Right now, we are looking for a Lead Portfolio Manager who likes making a difference!

Job description

As a Lead Portfolio Manager, you will join a team of skilled colleagues and contribute to Nordic RCC ambitious goals of green transition together with our owners in the 4 Nordic countries.

The Portfolio team is sitting in the PMO organization, together with Nordic Project Support team and the local project management team. You will report directly to the Head of PMO and have a close collaboration with the Senior Portfolio Manager and the local project management group, as well as the leadership team, Finance, and the manager of the Nordic Project Support team in PMO.

Responsibilities

Your tasks will include:

Portfolio management

  • Drive continuous optimization of the Nordic RCC project portfolio with a focus on efficiency and strategic alignment.

  • Lead financial budgeting and long-term planning in close collaboration with Finance.

  • Deliver monthly portfolio reporting, including dependency tracking, to the leadership team and relevant stakeholders.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Coordination

  • Foster collaboration between internal and external stakeholders to enhance efficiency and ensure continuous project execution.

  • Act as the central point of contact for project-related inquiries from local project managers and teams.

  • Maintain a comprehensive overview of project dependencies and support departments in addressing organizational challenges related to products, processes, and resources.

Governance & Best Practices

  • Own and maintain the project Stage-Gate model, including governance structures and project management guidance.

  • Ensure best practices are documented and prepare evidence for future audits.

  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying inefficiencies, standardizing processes, and enhancing project governance within the PMO.

Tools & Processes

  • Oversee portfolio and resource management processes and tools, ensuring they support strategic decision-making and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

  • Hold a master’s degree in mathematics, economics, engineering, or a related field.

  • Are proficient in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.

  • Exhibit strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.

  • Value teamwork and have a collaborative mindset.

  • Respectful of agreements, deadlines, other people’s time and ideas, and listening to customer needs.

  • Structured in your work and approach to tasks, working in an orderly manner.

  • Strong interpersonal skills

  • Advanced Excel skills

Requirements

  • Have significant experience (more than 5-10 years) as a Project Portfolio Manager or similar within the European renewable energy sector.

  • You bring a strong financial background and analytical mindset, enabling you to lead long-term planning and budgeting in close collaboration with Finance. Your financial insights make you a trusted advisor to the leadership team.

  • You like to prepare management reports, presentations and follow up on activities.

  • You like to gain and share knowledge/experience of various portfolio methods and processes.

  • Have experience with both portfolio management and project management

  • Knowledge of implementing IT solutions.

Employment conditions

You will join a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently more than 23 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined. 

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 15 November 2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

If any questions, please contact Head of PMO, Signe Uhre Guldfeldt by writing an email to sgu@nordic-rcc.net.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

jobs.title: Postdoc position in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence group at Luleå University of Technology develops autonomous robots for field use and has tested them in mines and other underground environments. We are now looking for a postdoctoral researcher to develop autonomy for teams of legged, wheeled and aerial robots in places with extended risk, such as underground mines and areas prone to rockfall. The work covers scene understanding with foundation models, navigation, and coordinated decisions within the robot team when communication is limited.



Subject description

Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.

  

Project description

The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence (RAI) group belongs to the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering. The group took part in the DARPA Subterranean Challenge with the CoSTAR team led by NASA/JPL. Its applications include robotics for mining, aerial inspection of ageing infrastructure, autonomy for space robotics and multi-robot search and rescue. More information is available at https://www.ltu.se/robotics.



Autonomous robots deployment in underground mines, areas prone to rockfall and other environments that are dangerous for people often need several robots working together. Communication between the robots is often intermittent, and each robot must interpret its surroundings well enough to judge risk on its own. Vision and language foundation models can support this kind of interpretation, but they rarely model the physics of the terrain or the dynamics of the robot. This position will develop methods that connect scene understanding, physics-informed navigation and coordination within the robot team, and validate them in real environments.

  

The research will focus on one or more of the following areas.



- Scene and context understanding with foundation models, for example vision-language models, in underground mines and areas prone to rockfall, including hazard identification and risk-aware traversability assessment



- Physics-informed foundation models for autonomous navigation, where learned models account for the robot's dynamics and the physical properties of the terrain



- Multi-robot collaboration over mesh networks, with shared mapping and coordinated decision making under intermittent communication



- Communication-aware planning of multi-robot missions that use 5G/6G infrastructure, where the robots plan their motion and tasks based on network coverage and capacity



- Experimental validation on legged, wheeled and aerial robots in underground and mining environments



Duties

The duties of a postdoctoral researcher are primarily research. The research has a substantial experimental part, with work on real robots and field experiments in mines and other underground environments. You will publish the results in international peer-reviewed journals and at major conferences. The position also includes co-supervision of PhD and master's students and taking part in applications for research funding from funding agencies, the EU framework programme and industry. Teaching may be included for at most one fifth of working time.



Qualifications

To be eligible for employment as a postdoctoral researcher, you must hold a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in robotics, automatic control, computer science, electrical engineering or a related subject. It is a merit if the doctoral degree was awarded no more than three years before the application deadline. Candidates who were awarded their doctoral degree earlier may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example different types of statutory leave.



You need a good knowledge of at least one of the following: robot perception, learning-based methods for robotics, multi-robot systems, or motion and mission planning. Previous work with experimentally verified results on real robots, in at least one of the research areas above, is required. You also need good programming skills in C++ and Python, and experience of ROS or ROS 2. Good oral and written English is required, since you will present the group's work in Sweden and abroad.



Experience of foundation models or vision-language models in robotics, of legged robots, of communication and mesh networking for robots, of wireless communication systems such as 5G or 6G, or of field experiments in underground environments is a merit.



Further information

This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension to a maximum of three years in total. The position is based in Luleå. The starting date is by agreement.



For further information about the position, please contact



Chaired Professor George Nikolakopoulos, +46 920-49 1298, mailto:geonik@ltu.se



Postdoctoral Researcher, Akash Patel, mailto:akash.patel@ltu.se



For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities and market conditions of the role.

Also include a research plan of at most two pages that describes how you would approach one or more of the research areas above, and the names and contact details of two references. jobs.title: Har du et ønske om å gjøre noe meningsfullt? Da trenger jeg deg!

jobs.description:
Jeg er en dame i midten av 50-årene med svært alvorlig ME som bor i Skien. På grunn av sykdommen er jeg sengeliggende i et mørkt rom, og jeg trenger assistanse til det aller meste.

Jeg er blid og omgjengelig, men trenger ro. Jeg ser etter assistenter som kan lese og forstå mine behov, og som viser forståelse for min situasjon. Det er viktig at du er fleksibel og kan jobbe på sykdommens premisser.

Jeg blir dårlig av stress, så det er viktig at du er en rolig person som kan jobbe selvstendig og ut ifra faste rutiner.

Arbeidsoppgaver inkluderer blant annet:

  • Bistand til ivaretakelse av personlig hygiene i seng

  • Assistanse til hårvask i seng

  • Skift og vask av sengetøy

  • Matlaging - Grunnet intoleranse for en del matprodukter er det viktig at du kan lage mat som ikke er helt ´standard´

  • Handling og praktiske gjøremål utenfor hjemmet ved behov

  • Husarbeid, vasking, rydding og klesvask

  • Lett massasje/tøying og hjelp til å øke blodsirkulasjonen

Om deg: 

Jeg ser etter deg som gjerne har noe erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker, og som har gode norske skriftlige og muntlige egenskaper. Du trenger ikke formell utdanning, men må ha plettfri politiattest. Du er røykfri, og ser gjerne etter et lengre tidsperspektiv i jobben. På grunn av luktsensitiviteten sykdommen gir meg, vil det ikke være mulig å bruke parfymerte produkter på jobb. For meg er det viktig at vi har god kjemi, så dette vil vektlegges.

  • Ryddig og strukturert

  • Voksen, stabil og trygg

  • Det er viktig for meg at du setter deg inn i hva sykdommen innebærer

  • Du må kunne jobbe i stillhet og dunkel belysning

  • Du er ansvarsfull, pålitelig og trives med å jobbe selvstendig

  • Positiv, trygg og tålmodig da dager kommer i alle farger

  • Omsorgsfull og snill, og rolig av natur.

  • På grunn av arbeidets art ønskes kvinnelig assistent


Jeg trenger assistenter til følgende stillinger:

1.Vikariat ifb med svangerskapspermisjon i 80% stilling - dag og kveldsvakter.

2.Tilkallingsassistenter som kan jobbe ved sykdom og ferie.

Hvis dette er noe som kan passe for deg, håper jeg at jeg hører fra deg!

Send en epost til gry.roede.almaas@stendi.no om du har spørsmål til stillingen.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stendi Assistanse er et av Norges største leverandører av assistanse- og hjemmetjenester til mennesker med hjelpebehov. Vi leverer tjenester på vegne av det offentlige. Gjennom vårt arbeid ønsker vi å gjøre verden litt bedre, ett menneske av gangen. Sammen med våre oppdragsgivere skaper vi en trygg omsorg som ivaretar alle!

Vi har et landsdekkende tjenestetilbud innen brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) og hjemmebaserte tjenester.

jobs.title: HR-Rådgiver
jobs.description:
Som HR-rådgiver vil du være en viktig støtte for ledere i både daglige og komplekse HR-spørsmål. Du vil bidra til gode rekrutteringsprosesser, sikre etterlevelse av lov- og avtaleverk, bistå i arbeidsrettslige spørsmål og være en sentral aktør i utviklings- og omstillingsarbeid. Rollen innebærer også ansvar for sentrale samarbeidsarenaer som medbestemmelse og arbeidsmiljøutvalg, samt arbeid innen HMS, analyse og organisasjonsutvikling.  

Dette er en nøkkelrolle for deg som ønsker å kombinere HR-faglig dybde med reell påvirkningskraft. Som HR-rådgiver får du arbeide tett på ledelsen og bidra til viktige beslutninger som påvirker både medarbeidere, arbeidsmiljø og virksomhetens utvikling. Rollen spenner fra operative HR-prosesser til strategisk rådgivning, og gir en unik mulighet til å jobbe bredt innen rekruttering, arbeidsrett, organisasjonsutvikling, medbestemmelse, HMS og lederstøtte. Du vil være en sentral sparringspartner i komplekse HR-saker, samtidig som du får bidra til å utvikle en profesjonell, helhetlig og fremtidsrettet arbeidsgiverpraksis. For deg som motiveres av samfunnsoppdraget, samarbeid og muligheten til å skape varige forbedringer, er dette en rolle med både faglig bredde, ansvar og utviklingsmuligheter. 

Halden kommune ligger 90 minutters kjøring fra Oslo, 20 minutter fra vår naboby Strømstad og 2 timer fra Gøteborg. Kommunen ligger idyllisk ved sjøen og har et ypperlig turterreng. Arbeidsmarkedet finner vi på begge sider av landegrensen, og kommunen har et aktivt og rikt kultur- og organisasjonsliv. 

Nav Halden – Aremark består av ca. 90 medarbeidere, fordelt på fire avdelinger og en stabsfunksjon med dyktige ansatte som leverer gode tjenester til innbyggerne i begge kommunene. Våre tjenester skal i størst mulig grad være tilpasset hver enkelt innbyggers behov, der veiledernes kompetanse matches med det behovet innbyggeren har. 


Arbeidsoppgaver

Rådgivning og støtte til ledere: 

  • innen HR, personalforvaltning og arbeidsrett 
  • ved ansettelser, herunder skriving av behovsanalyser, annonsering, intervjureferater og innstillinger 
  • ved behov i personalsaker, sykefraværsoppfølging og nærværsarbeid 
  • ved planlegging og koordinering av medbestemmelsesprosesser og arbeidsmiljøutvalg 
  • utviklings- og omstillingsprosesser 
  • oppfølging av lønnsprosesser og rådgivning i lønnspolitiske spørsmål 
  • utarbeidelse av analyser og beslutningsgrunnlag knyttet til blant annet sykefravær, bemanning og organisasjonsutvikling 
  • utvikling og kvalitetssikring av HR-rutiner, rollebeskrivelser o.l. 
  • oppfølging av HMS-arbeid og utvikling av arbeidsmiljø  
  • samarbeid med tillitsvalgte, vernetjeneste, bedriftshelsetjeneste og andre samarbeidspartnere  
Kvalifikasjoner

Dersom du vil bli HR-Rådgiver hos oss må du ha: 

  • Relevant høyere utdanning på minimum bachelornivå innen HR, organisasjon, ledelse, arbeidsrett, statsvitenskap eller tilsvarende. Relevant erfaring kan veie opp for         utdanningskravet
  • God kunnskap om arbeidsrettslig lovgivning og sentrale deler av statlig avtaleverk 
  • Erfaring fra HR-arbeid, personalforvaltning og/eller arbeidsgiverstøtte 
  • Erfaring med rådgivning til ledere 
  • Erfaring med rekruttering og ansettelsesprosesser, fortrinnsvis i offentlig sektor 
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk 
  • God digital kompetanse og erfaring med bruk av HR- og saksbehandlingssystemer 

Kravene må kunne dokumenteres og all utenlandsk utdanning må være Hk.dir/Nokut godkjent.

Det er en fordel om du også har: 

  • Erfaring fra offentlig sektor, gjerne statlig virksomhet 
  • Erfaring med arbeidsmiljøarbeid, sykefraværsoppfølging og HMS 
  • Erfaring med medbestemmelse, partsamarbeid eller arbeid i AMU 
  • Kunnskap om lønnsdannelse og lokale lønnsforhandlinger 
  • Erfaring med organisasjonsutvikling, endringsarbeid eller omstillingsprosesser 
  • Erfaring med HR-analyser, rapportering og bruk av styringsdata 
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som: 

  • Har høy faglig integritet og rolleforståelse 
  • Evner å bygge gode relasjoner og skape tillit 
  • Er strukturert, selvstendig og leverer med høy kvalitet 
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og trives i samspill med ledere, ansatte og tillitsvalgte 
  • Kan håndtere komplekse problemstillinger og gjøre gode faglige vurderinger 
  • Evner å kombinere strategisk tenkning med operativ gjennomføring.  

Personlig egnethet vil bli særlig vektlagt. 

Vi tilbyr

Vi ønsker å gjøre jobbsøkerprosessen så enkel som mulig. Derfor trenger du ikke å skrive jobbsøknad til denne stillingen.En oppdatert og utfyllende CV, sammen med svar på screeningspørsmål er derfor mer enn nok.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. jobs.title: 30 årig tjej i Örebro söker ny assistent
jobs.description:
Introduktion

Välkommen till en spännande möjlighet hos AssistansExperten! Vi söker en engagerad och omtänksam assistent som vill arbeta med en 30-årig tjej i Örebro. Som personlig assistent kommer du att spela en avgörande roll i hennes vardag och bidra till att skapa en trygg och meningsfull tillvaro. Hos oss värdesätter vi både våra kunder och medarbetare, och vi strävar efter att bygga långvariga relationer präglade av respekt och värme. Om du är en person som brinner för att hjälpa andra och vill vara en del av ett stöttande team, då är detta rätt plats för dig!

Om rollen

I rollen som personlig assistent kommer du att arbeta 50% för att stödja en ung kvinna i hennes dagliga liv. Det innebär att du kommer att vara en viktig del av hennes rutiner och aktiviteter, och hjälpa till med både praktiska och sociala uppgifter. Du kommer att få möjlighet att lära känna henne och anpassa ditt stöd efter hennes unika behov och önskemål. Vi söker någon som är flexibel och beredd att arbeta varierande scheman, inklusive förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och eventuellt helger. Tillsammans med oss på AssistansExperten kommer du att få chansen att utvecklas och växa i din roll som personlig assistent.

Arbetsuppgifter

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att vara varierande och anpassade efter kundens behov. Du kommer att:

    Stötta kunden i dagliga aktiviteter som personlig hygien, påklädning och måltidsförberedelser.
    Hjälpa till med transport och följa med på aktiviteter utanför hemmet, som att träffa vänner och delta i fritidsaktiviteter.
    Ge medicinsk hjälp vid behov, inklusive att hantera kundens epilepsi med kunskap och omsorg.
    Skapa en trygg och positiv miljö som uppmuntrar till delaktighet och självständighet.

Vi tror att ett nära samarbete med kunden är avgörande för att leverera högkvalitativ assistans och för att skapa en meningsfull relation.

Kvalifikationer

För att trivas och lyckas i denna roll krävs följande kvalifikationer:

    Du måste vara hästvan, då kunden har ett stort intresse för hästar och aktiviteter relaterade till detta.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med personer med epilepsi är ett krav, för att säkerställa att rätt stöd kan ges vid behov.
    Du bör inte vara pälsdjursallergiker

Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet inom personlig assistans eller liknande vårdroller, men det är inte ett krav.

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, tålmodig och har en positiv attityd. Du bör vara en person som trivs med att arbeta nära andra och har en genuin vilja att göra skillnad i någons liv. Det är viktigt att du är flexibel och kan anpassa dig efter kundens behov och önskemål. En god kommunikationsförmåga och förmågan att samarbeta med både kunden och andra medarbetare är avgörande för att skapa en bra arbetsmiljö. Om du är kreativ och kan hitta på roliga aktiviteter som engagerar kunden, kommer du att passa perfekt i vårt team.

Ansökningsprocess

Är du intresserad av att bli en del av vårt team och göra skillnad i en ung kvinnas liv? Vi ser fram emot att ta emot din ansökan! Skicka in ditt CV och ett personligt brev där du berättar om dig själv och varför du är rätt person för denna roll. Vi kommer att intervjua kandidater löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor kring tjänsten eller ansökningsprocessen.

Vid arbete hos äldre eller vuxna med funktionsnedsättning

Arbete i hemmet hos äldre personer eller vuxna personer med funktionsnedsättning omfattas av registerkontroll enligt Lag (2026:43) om registerkontroll vid arbete i hemmet åt äldre personer eller vuxna personer med funktionsnedsättning. Lagen gäller från och med den 1 mars 2026. I stöd av lagen har vi som företag en policy att begära utdrag ur belastningsregistret i samband med nyanställning. Registerkontrollen genomförs som ett sista steg i rekryteringsprocessen och utgör en del av vår samlade lämplighetsbedömning. https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/arbete-i-hemmet-med-aldre-och-personer-med-funktionsnedsattning-e-tjanst/

Kontaktinformation

För mer information om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta oss på AssistansExperten. Du kan nå oss via e-post på mailto:linda@assistansexperten.se. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig och att tillsammans skapa en trygg och meningsfull assistans!

jobs.title: Research associate: AI
jobs.employer: Stift The Stockholm Environment Institute, Sei
jobs.description:
The role combines hands-on evidence synthesis with the development and evaluation of AI-driven approaches to make evidence synthesis processes more efficient. You will work on manual evidence-synthesis tasks, while also using Python and/or R to build and validate machine learning, automation and AI-assisted workflows for searching, eligibility screening, and (meta)data extraction. Your work will also contribute to new meta-research on how, and under what conditions, automated and AI-based tools can speed up and improve evidence synthesis in the environmental field without compromising reliability, robustness or scientific quality.

Our team spans many disciplines and we welcome candidates from different backgrounds. If you have strong research and programming skills, want to help connect sustainability science with policymaking and are keen to learn evidence synthesis methods, we would like to hear from you.

Key tasks and responsibilities

Conduct and support manual literature searching, screening and (meta)data extraction for evidence synthesis projects, working with large volumes of scientific publications and grey literature (including bibliographic information and textual data).

Develop and maintain reproducible workflows in Python and/or R for screening, extraction, classification, quality-checking, cleaning and harmonization of textual and bibliographic data.

Apply and evaluate machine learning, natural language processing and LLM-based methods for text classification, information extraction and document analysis.

Validate automated and AI-generated outputs against human decisions, quantifying errors, uncertainty and potential biases.

Document methods, decisions and validation procedures to support transparent and reproducible research.

Work collaboratively with researchers across environmental, sustainability, climate, energy and social science.

Who you are

You are an early-career researcher with strong analytical and programming skills who enjoys working where sustainability research meets technology development – engaging with both the details of evidence synthesis and the computational methods that support it.

You are happy to do detailed manual eligibility screening and (meta) data extraction, while looking for opportunities to automate these processes and make them more efficient.

You have a background in, or strong interest in, sustainability or environmental research and enjoy learning from people with different disciplinary backgrounds.

You do not need to be an expert in every method or technology used in this role. We value someone who is curious, careful, quick to learn and a constructive team player.

The role would suit someone with:

    Programming and data analysis skills in Python and/or R, including version control with GitHub
    Experience handling large volumes of structured and unstructured text
    Practical experience applying machine learning, NLP or large language models to text classification, information extraction or eligibility screening
    An interest in evidence synthesis methodology
    Knowledge of, or interest in, sustainability or environmental research

Experience with more advanced AI development, such as model fine-tuning or deployment, is welcome but deep expertise in machine learning or software engineering is not required.

Experience with any of the following is highly desirable, but not required:

    Literature reviews, including systematic, scoping and rapid reviews
    Working with bibliographic datasets
    Literature eligibility screening or (meta)data extraction

Formal qualifications

    A master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, socio-environmental science, sustainability science or a related field.
    Early-career experience (1–2 years) in academic or applied research involving data analysis and AI/data-driven methods.

Personal skills

    Collaborative: comfortable working in teams and across disciplinary boundaries.
    Analytical and critical: able to assess evidence and critically evaluate AI-generated results.
    Systematic and data-oriented: enjoys turning complex information into reliable datasets.
    Clear communicator: able to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
    Curious and adaptable: interested in learning and applying rapidly developing AI methods.
    Quality-focused and responsible: attentive to research integrity, transparency, uncertainty and AI-related risks.

Additional information

You will join the International Climate Risk and Adaptation Team, which develops and applies pioneering research methods to define, describe, measure and communicate systemic climate risk in interdependent global systems. Drawing on diverse perspectives, its work spans quantitative and qualitative analysis, climate risk assessment, scenario and foresight development and AI-driven policy analysis.

Our offer

At SEI HQ we offer a stimulating position in an international environment. You will be part of a leading, multinational, multidisciplinary and multilingual team of experts in an organization where the well-being and development of our employees is of high priority. We value diversity and creativity at the core of what we do and we welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply. Our ambition is to provide a safe, professional, and creative workspace for all.

An employment with SEI HQ includes:

    Collective Agreement incl. occupational pension and many other collectively agreed benefits
    An annual healthcare contribution and additional benefits connected to promoting our employees’ wellbeing such as yearly health check-ups
    Opportunities for professional growth and development
    Flexible working hours, 37.5-hour workweek and a generous amount of vacation days
    Being part of tackling environmental and development challenges and developing solutions for a sustainable future for all.

Once employed, you must live in Sweden, preferably in the Stockholm area. It is not possible to work from another country.

How to apply

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis. Please submit your application as soon as possible, and no later than 26 October 2026, 23:59 Stockholm local time.

Applications must be written in English and submitted through our recruitment system. Please include:

    Cover letter highlighting relevant qualifications and experience (no more than two pages)
    Curriculum vitae (no more than four pages)

Please note that we screen all applicants manually. Incomplete applications will not be accepted.

jobs.title: Min super-BPA har flyttet. Er du min nye Hans?
jobs.employer: MEDVIND ASSISTANSE AS AVD MØRE OG ROMSDAL
jobs.description:
Bare for å si det med en gang. Lista er høy. Hans har vært meget flink i jobben sin, og jeg har hatt lite å utsette på han. Rent bortsett fra at han har sluttet.

Hans har jobbet hos meg i et par år i en full stilling. Så, er du min nye Hans?

Hans har vært umåtelig positiv, raskt på ballen, en gledesspreder og særdeles flink i jobben sin. Han har vært tillitsfull, kul og bydd på seg selv. Hans har glidd perfekt inn med guttegjengen på 14 år, og har selvsagt ikke hatt noe problem med å kjøre bil med manuelt gir.

Hans har løftet meg fra rullestolen til senga, til fotball-rullestolen, og han har vært med på mange skoledager og fotballtreninger. God i kanonball var han faktisk også, som er positivt siden jeg trenger litt hjelp til å delta på slike aktiviteter.
Hans var ikke treg ut av startblokkene. Når ting skjer, så var han på beina umiddelbart slik jeg ikke henger bak resten av kompisgjengen, enten det er å få på meg sko og jakke, eller det er andre ting, som å få litt salt på maten..

Hans har vært en mester på å hjelpe meg og kompisgjengen med påfyll av drikke, og er godt kjent i huset slik jeg klarer meg fint alene uten foreldrene mine, slik som kompisene mine også kan!

Hans har deltatt på sine timer med Playstation også. Kult med en assistent som både er god i Fifa, Formel 1, og kanskje litt andre spill i blant også..

Det viktigste av alt er at Hans har vært til å stole på, og at han ikke bruker så langt tid på å hive seg rundt. Fleksibel og alltid positiv og et smil om munnen har han alltid hatt. Og det er faktisk litt dritt at han nå har flyttet og sluttet.

Jeg trenger derfor en ny Hans. Eller en som er like flink som Hans, og at du føler deg kapabel til å prøve deg i hans sko?

Som Hans kan det fort være aktuelt med en stor stilling, men den kan også deles opp om det er mest aktuelt.

Jeg er en gutt i min beste alder, 14 år og er straks ferdig med første året på ungdomsskolen, spiller fotball noen dager i uken, og elsker gaming og henge med kompiser. Du kan gjerne være aktuell for både dagvakt og kveldsvakt, såvel som helger.

 

Du vil få opplæring, men det er viktig for meg at du er litt som Hans som alltid har vært positiv, rask på beina, bydd på seg selv og funnet løsninger. Når man er påskrudd så blir jeg fort tryggere på deg jeg også.
Det kan fort bli store sko å fylle, men om du føler deg klar til å prøve så skjønner du kanskje hva du må gjøre..

På grunn av stillingens natur oppfordres spesielt mannlige kandidater til å søke. 

- Mulige stillinger kan være tilkalling, deltid (større og mindre stillinger)

- Gjerne mulighet for å jobbe natt også.

 

NB! Søkere vil bli vurdert fortløpende, og ikke etter endt søknadsfrist.
