jobs.title: AI Deployment Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

  • Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

  • Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About the Team

The AI Deployment (Customer Implementation) Team at Gorgias is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and successful start for every customer's journey with our products. Our primary objective is to elevate the onboarding experience by delivering a white-glove service and expert guidance to our customers. This involves cultivating a heightened proficiency in product knowledge, engaging in consultative conversations, and adopting a strategic implementation approach that extends beyond mere activation. Our mission is to empower companies to launch swiftly and effectively on Gorgias, showcasing the exceptional value of our flagship products: Helpdesk and AI Agent.

Our team plays a pivotal role in the overall success of our products, influencing customer adoption, usage, and retention. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions.

 

About the Role

As the AI Deployment Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding.

 

What You'll Do

  • Conduct in-depth discovery and implementation sessions for your book of business, tailoring the experience to drive adoption and usage of our Helpdesk and AI Agent products.

  • Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals.

  • Design and drive AI Agent adoption roadmaps for each customer, sequencing automation rollout to support change management and prove value at each stage.

  • Drive the activation ratio and reduce time to value through a white-glove experience, providing expert guidance on both Helpdesk and AI Agent configuration.

  • Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and communicating the business impact of AI adoption in clear, compelling terms.

  • Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and cross-functional accountability throughout the onboarding process.

  • Manage integrations with the customer's ecommerce tech stack; explore feasibility of custom integration paths and troubleshoot proactively using available technical resources and AI tools.

  • Drive project timelines through clear milestone setting and workback schedules, ensuring effective project management throughout the implementation.

  • Analyze and interpret e-commerce customer data to build compelling, executive-ready narratives - translating support metrics and AI Agent outcomes into business impact framed around revenue, efficiency, and risk, so that CEOs and CFOs become champions, not blockers.

  • Document customer interactions, configurations, and learnings meticulously - contributing insights that improve future implementations and team best practices.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate roadblocks to decrease time to value, and coach L1/L2 peers by sharing patterns, playbooks, and implementation learnings.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, solution design, and documentation.

 

Who You Are

  • Experience: 3–5+ years in SaaS as an implementation manager or similar post-sales role, driving adoption and activation with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering complex implementations. Ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

  • Consultancy and Project Management: 3–5+ years crafting and overseeing project timelines tailored to enhance activation among merchants, encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions. Comfortable managing 25-30 accounts simultaneously with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and executive presence. You build compelling narratives that resonate at the CEO and CFO level - translating complex data and AI outcomes into clear business impact, overcoming objections before they become roadblocks, and turning skeptics into champions. You adapt your message and materials to any audience.

  • Technical Curiosity: You understand how ecommerce platforms and integrations work, you're comfortable exploring how to build or troubleshoot integrations, and you default to resourcefulness over escalation. Familiarity with Shopify and common ecommerce tech stacks is a strong plus.

  • AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI Agent, discussing automation strategy with merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly. Proactively uses tools like Claude to improve your own efficiency.

  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.

  • Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on driving engagement, product adoption, and mitigating churn.

  • Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth. You stay current on Gorgias product developments and ecommerce trends, and you actively contribute to team knowledge.

AI at Gorgias
At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias

Vi på WeStaff Sweden söker nu en tekniker inom elektronikproduktion till ett etablerat teknik- och industriföretag i norra Stockholm. I rollen får du arbeta med felsökning, testning, reparation och verifiering av elektronikkort och system, samtidigt som du fungerar som ett tekniskt stöd till produktionen.

Det här är en roll för dig som gillar att förstå varför något inte fungerar, hitta lösningen och driva problemet hela vägen i mål.

Om tjänsten

Som tekniker arbetar du nära produktionen och ansvarar för att identifiera, analysera och åtgärda tekniska problem inom elektronik. Du kommer att arbeta både praktiskt med elektronikkort och system samt med analys, dokumentation och förbättringsarbete.

Rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar. Du förväntas kunna driva tekniska ärenden självständigt, samtidigt som du samarbetar med exempelvis produktion, kvalitet, konstruktion och produktionsteknik för att hitta långsiktiga lösningar.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

    

Felsöka, reparera och verifiera elektronikkort och system

    

Utföra funktionstester och felanalyser på komponent-, kort- och systemnivå

    

Stötta produktionen vid tekniska avvikelser och kvalitetsärenden

    

Genomföra och dokumentera rotorsaksanalyser samt föreslå korrigerande åtgärder

    

Arbeta med omarbetning och modifiering av kretskort

    

Läsa och tolka elscheman, ritningar och teknisk dokumentation

    

Använda test- och mätutrustning vid felsökning

    

Delta vid introduktion av nya produkter och produktionsprocesser

    

Bidra till utveckling av arbetsinstruktioner och standardiserade arbetssätt

    

Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med produktion, kvalitet, konstruktion och produktionsteknik

    

Identifiera och driva förbättringar inom kvalitet, effektivitet och arbetssätt

    

Dokumentera tekniska ärenden och säkerställa uppföljning till avslutad lösning

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har ett starkt teknikintresse och erfarenhet av elektronikproduktion, PCBA eller elektroniktest. Du är analytisk och metodisk i ditt arbetssätt och trivs med att självständigt felsöka och lösa tekniska problem.

Du behöver vara bekväm med att ta ansvar för dina egna ärenden och kunna planera, prioritera och driva arbetet framåt. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera med olika funktioner.

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är en person som gärna går till botten med ett problem och inte släpper det förrän du hittat en hållbar lösning.

Krav

    

Gymnasieutbildning inom elektronik, elteknik eller motsvarande teknisk utbildning

    

Flera års erfarenhet av elektronikproduktion, PCBA eller elektroniktest

    

God erfarenhet av felsökning inom elektronik

    

Förmåga att läsa och förstå elscheman, ritningar och teknisk dokumentation

    

God datorvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i affärs-/produktionssystem

    

God svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande

    

IPC-A-610, IPC-7711/7721 eller motsvarande

    

Erfarenhet av SAP eller annat ERP-system

    

Erfarenhet av högmix-/lågvolymproduktion

    

Erfarenhet av ESD-skyddade produktionsmiljöer

    

Erfarenhet av multimeter, oscilloskop eller annan test- och mätutrustning

    

Erfarenhet av programmeringsutrustning

    

Erfarenhet av Lean, 5S eller förbättringsarbete

    

Erfarenhet av kvalitetsarbete, avvikelsehantering och rotorsaksanalyser

Praktisk information

Start: Omgående/enligt överenskommelse Omfattning: Heltid Arbetstid: Dagtid, måndag–fredag Plats: Norra Stockholm Upplägg: Långsiktigt

Om WeStaff Sweden AB

WeStaff Sweden AB är ett växande konsult- och rekryteringsföretag inom Produktion & Tillverkning. Våra värderingar bygger på personlig relation, trygghet och långsiktighet.

Vi är ett kunskapsdrivet team med över 30 års samlad erfarenhet från branschen. Vårt arbete kännetecknas av kvalitet, nytänkande och ett personligt engagemang. Läs mer om oss på www.westaff.se

Vill du bli en del av oss? Ansök redan idag och bli vår nästa medarbetare!

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager - CBRE, Data Centre Solutions

We are recruiting a Project Manager to join our specialist Data Centre Solutions team, located in Sweden - Stockholm - Rosersberg, reporting to the Oscar Fristedt Business Unit Head of Projects for Nordics

Job Purpose

To lead delivery of mechanical, electrical, fabric or construction projects varying in value, following the project management process from cradle to grave (meeting with the customer, developing a scope of works, putting together a tender and delivering the projects on site through to handover).


This role will involve one client. The role is managed on site together with already existing project manager and operations.

Role Summary:

The purpose of the role is to:


    Deliver projects from start to end.
    Ensure projects are secured and delivered on time and within the financial requirements and margins as specified by the business.
    Ensure that all projects adhere and are managed to commercial agreements / contracts. They must comply with statutory regulations, are QHSE compliant and meet technical industry standards.

General Activities:


    Ensure the safe delivery of projects through the management of risk and competence.
    Provide leadership in identifying and specifying project opportunities.
    Deliver contractual commitments on secured projects.
    Ensure projects are delivered on all maintenance contracts.
    Complete projects on time and on budget and to the satisfaction of all parties.
    Identify, reduce and manage all risks (technical, statutory, health and safety, commercial or otherwise) associated with each and every project.
    Maximise profit through cost reductions and better buying of subcontractor services.
    Identify and win project through effective relationships.
    Deliver supportive business communication through advice, review, leadership and direct contribution to management team meetings, briefings, consultation forums, correspondence, publicity, monthly and ad-hoc reporting and other applications as appropriate.
    Promote and maintain the core values of CBRE.

Business Development:


    Plan and develop long term opportunities by creating a pipeline of opportunities.
    Develop and manage all bids, tenders and proposals.
    Seek out opportunities to generate projects through innovation and different technologies

Building Relationships:


    Develop effective relationships with current and potential customers through demonstrating our capability in project delivery solutions.
    Build strong relationships with supply partners through which we can bring innovation to our customers.
    Ensure effective solutions which meet quality expectations can be delivered to our customers.
    Work with operational managers to ensure the collaborative development of the projects business with effective team working and support of colleagues.

Compliance:


    Make certain that their team comply with project management policies and procedures.
    Ensure compliance with health and safety policy across all activities. Regularly audit and review performance.
    Engage with supply partners in a manner that ensures all risk is appropriately apportioned.

Financial management:


    Development of project financial plans.
    Financial responsibility for the delivery of the annual projects plan.
    Produce monthly and ad hoc financial reports for the Head of Projects.
    Leverage margins on projects by working with subcontractors and suppliers to reduce project costs.
    Ensure positive cash flow.
    Chair monthly project reviews with BULs, PM's, Project Support, Finance Manager, Procurement Manager, Health & Safety Manager and Commercial Manager.

Experience Required:

Skills:


    Commercial awareness
    Financial acumen
    Influencing, selling and negotiation skills
    Understand commercial and financial metrics
    Internal customer management
    Networking skills

Knowledge:


    Knowledge of the construction market
    Project management methodology
    Broad understanding of construction Health and Safety law and legislation
    Understanding of general financial terminology.

Experience:


    Proven project management experience in either an M&E, FM, construction or critical environment
    Experience of developing new project opportunities
    Experience of creating, presenting and managing on bids, tenders and proposals.

Qualifications:


    Recognised technical qualification in either a construction, mechanical or electrical discipline.
    Business standard of written and verbal literacy as well as above average numeracy skills
    Recognised qualification in project management
    English and Swedish - writing and speaking.

Aptitude:


    Highly developed interpersonal and communication skills
    An excellent relationship builder
    Ability to inspire confidence
    Challenge status quo
    High degree of integrity
    Highly motivated and self-aware
    Highly organised with attention to detail
    Ability to network
    Results focused
    Innovative
    Handle high levels of information from a wide range of sources

jobs.title: Biluthyrare
jobs.description:
Låt oss skapa framtidens mobilitet tillsammans!

Din Bil, en del av Porsche Holding Salzburg GmbH och Volkswagen AG, är en ledande aktör i den svenska bilbranschen med märken som Volkswagen, Audi, Seat, Škoda, CUPRA, Porsche, Volkswagen transportbilar och Europcar. Med 68 anläggningar och cirka 2400 medarbetare i Stockholm, Göteborg, västra Skåne samt Gävleborg-Dalarna erbjuder vi karriärmöjligheter inom försäljning, service, verkstad och administrativa roller. Vår värdegrund, som betonar driv, integritet och hållbarhet, främjar en inkluderande och dynamisk arbetsplats. Vi satsar på medarbetarutveckling och en hälsosam arbetsmiljö. Om du delar vår vision och har de kvaliteter vi söker, så är du precis den personen vi vill ha ombord. Välkommen till Din Bil!

Arbetsuppgifter

Som biluthyrare är din huvudsakliga arbetsuppgift att ta hand om våra kunder som hyr bil hos oss genom att ge den bästa servicen och kundupplevelsen från det att kunden får nycklarna i handen till dess att bilen är tvättad efter hyra.

Mer specifikt innebär rollen att ta emot kunder över disk, administrativa uppgifter som att redovisa hyresavtal samt andra vanligt förekommande kontorsuppgifter. Tillsammans med bilvårdare klarställa bilar vilket innebär rengöring av bilen både in- och utvändigt, tanka samt att genomföra skadebesiktningar enligt Europcars standard.

Du kommer huvudsakligen vara placerad på vårt uthyrningskontor i Trelleborg. I arbetet ingår även ett nära samarbete med våra andra uthyrningskontor på Din Bil. Det innebär att du ibland kan komma att arbeta på något av våra andra kontor. Tjänsten avser en tillsvidareanställning med start så snart som möjligt, 6 månaders provanställning tillämpas. Arbetstiden är schemalagd enligt stationens öppettider, helgarbete kan förekomma med jourtjänstgöring.

Vem är du?

För att du ska trivas och vara rätt person för tjänsten är det en förutsättning att du är serviceinriktad och duktig på kundbemötande. Sälj- och kommunikationsförmåga är två viktiga egenskaper. Du har god samarbetsförmåga och är självständig, entusiastisk och positiv. Vidare är du stresstålig, lösningsorienterad och har förmåga att prioritera ditt arbete. Vi ser även att du har god administrativ förmåga och är noggrann.

    B-körkort är ett krav
    Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt
    Goda kunskaper i MS Office-paketet
    Tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet från service och försäljning är meriterande

Vårt erbjudande till dig

Din Bil är så mycket mer än bara bilar. Genom förmånliga medarbetarerbjudanden och kompetensutveckling vill vi skapa en attraktiv arbetsplats för dig som jobbar hos oss.

Redo för nästa steg?

Vi ser fram emot att veta mer om dig i din ansökan innan sista ansökningsdag. För frågor om tjänsten vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef. Din Bil genomför i samtliga rekryteringar en kontroll av meritförteckning, vitsord och vandelsprövning innan anställning. Din Bil eftersträvar jämställdhet och mångfald. Vi värdesätter de kvaliteter som en jämn könsfördelning samt etnisk och kulturell mångfald tillför en verksamhet.

jobs.title: Timvikarier sökes till vår barnkund i centrala Umeå + Tavelsjö
jobs.description:
På Aktiv Assistans arbetar vi tillsammans för alla människors rätt till att leva livet fullt ut. Nu söker vi ytterligare kollegor till vårt team, är det du?

OM TJÄNSTEN

Vi på Aktiv Assistans söker två personliga assistenter till vår kund. Kunden bor växelvis i de centrala delarna av Umeå och i Tavelsjö, och assistansen utförs därför på båda platserna.

Vi söker just nu två timvikarier som kan arbeta vid ordinarie personals sjukfrånvaro eller ledighet. Du arbetar kvällar och vaken natt på vardagar och helger.

Arbetstider:

    

Kl. 15.30-21.30

    

Kl. 21.30-08.00

Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse där vi gärna ser att du kan påbörja introduktion omgående.

OM KUNDEN

Vår kund är en aktiv och energifylld 10-årig pojke som gillar traktorer, pussla och att vara utomhus. Han behöver stöd i sin dagliga livsföring. Han trivs bäst med en tydlig struktur och behöver mycket tillsyn samt uppmärksamhet från sina assistenter. Vid kommunikation används bildstöd, scheman och enkel, tydlig vägledning.

ÄR DU DEN VI SÖKER?

Då kunden tycker om och mår bra av att få röra på sig söker vi dig med god fysik som trivs i ett högre tempo. Du behöver kunna hänga med i kundens tempo och delta i aktiviteter som att cykla och leka utomhus.

Vi söker dig som är trygg, uppmärksam och lösningsorienterad. Ett positivt bemötande och god personkemi är avgörande för att skapa en bra relation med kunden. För att bidra till hans trygghet ser vi gärna att du har en långsiktig inställning till din anställning.

Om du känner att detta stämmer in på dig, kan du vara den vi söker!

KRAV

    

Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska

    

B-körkort + tillgång till bil

MERITER

    

Erfarenhet av arbete inom personlig assistans och/eller annan vårderfarenhet

    

God fysik samt intresse för att delta i fysiska aktiviteter och utomhuslek med lite högre tempo

    

Erfarenhet av epilepsi

    

Erfarenhet av autism

Sysselsättningsgrad: 2 st timvikarier vid behov.

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Övriga ersättningar i enlighet med kollektivavtal.

Din ansökan kommer att läsas av medarbetare på Aktiv Assistans, kund och anhörig. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

För anställning hos oss på Aktiv Assistans behöver du ha ett BankID och godkänner att använda ditt BankID i tjänsten. En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och/eller lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete i Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ned på Skatteverkets hemsida. För att kunna jobba som personlig assistent behöver du vara minst 18 år.

Om du ska arbeta med barn och unga under 18 år krävs att du uppvisar utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Från och med den 1 mars 2026 gäller nya bestämmelser som innebär att registerkontrollen omfattar både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag ur misstankeregistret. Utdraget beställs av via Polismyndighetens e-tjänst. Observera att handläggningstiden kan variera, varför beställning bör göras i god tid.

Utdragen kan beställas med BankID via följande länk: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/

Vi rekommenderar att du säkerställer att du har aktuella utdrag i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning och de nya regler som träder i kraft den 1 mars 2026.

Jobba hos Aktiv Assistans Norr AB

Aktiv Assistans Norr AB är ett familjärt assistansföretag med huvudsaklig verksamhet i Västerbotten. Vi brinner för att hjälpa personer med funktionsvariationer att leva ett så meningsfullt och rikt liv som möjligt, utifrån deras behov och önskemål. Våra ledord – inflytande, trygghet, tillgänglighet och kompetens – genomsyrar allt vi gör. Vi är lika måna om våra kunder som om våra anställda och strävar efter att skapa en arbetsplats där alla trivs och utvecklas.

Förmåner för dig som anställd hos Aktiv Assistans

Som personlig assistent hos oss omfattas du av kollektivavtal och avtalspension. Du är försäkrad både under arbetstid och på väg till och från jobbet, så att du kan känna dig trygg om något oförutsett skulle ske. Vi erbjuder även friskvårdsbidrag till alla våra medarbetare och arrangerar regelbundet aktiviteter för både personal och kunder. Vi är måna om att du ska trivas hos oss och känna dig som en del av gemenskapen!

Delning av ansökningar inom Team Olivia

För att ge dig bästa möjliga chanser att hitta rätt tjänst kan din ansökan komma att delas med våra systerbolag inom Team Olivia, om din profil matchar en ledig tjänst där. Självklart sker detta endast med ditt godkännande, vilket du anger i samband med din ansökan.

För dig med anställningsstöd

Om du har rätt till anställningsstöd tar vi hänsyn till detta vid en eventuell anställning. Att ange denna information i din ansökan är helt frivilligt – alternativt kan du välja att informera oss vid en eventuell intervju. Vi ser detta som en möjlighet att tillsammans skapa en bra lösning för dig som medarbetare.

jobs.title: Kære køkkenchef – vil du sætte smag på hverdagen på HF-VUC Aarhus?
jobs.description:
Vil du sætte dit eget præg på menuen og stå i spidsen for et køkken, hvor madglæde og godt samarbejde går hånd i hånd? Hos DinnerdeLuxe får du plads til at udfolde dine idéer og udvikle et team på tre medarbejdere. Med arbejdstider mellem kl. 6 og 16 er der også plads til livet uden for køkkenet.

Stillingen er krydret med:

·         37 timer om ugen med arbejdstider inden for tidsrummet kl. 6–16.

·         Kreativ frihed og indflydelse på menuerne med plads til at udvikle både maden og dig selv.

·         Et stærkt fællesskab med fokus på trivsel, samarbejde og bæredygtighed.

·         Tæt sparring med vores drifts- og kundechef om både køkkenet og din rolle som leder.

·         Et varieret arbejde med gode udviklingsmuligheder.

·         Løn efter kvalifikationer og sundhedsordning.

”Det vigtigste for mig er, at det går godt, at folk er glade, og at vi har det godt sammen. Vi griner, vi hygger os – og det kan mærkes i den mad, vi laver.”

-          Lasse Gorm Boelskifte, køkkenchef hos DinnerdeLuxe

Her er madglæde en del af hverdagen

Vi leder efter en køkkenchef, der har lyst til at bringe både faglighed, kreativitet og godt lederskab i spil. Du motiverer dit team, skaber overblik og brænder for mad, som gæsterne har lyst til at komme tilbage til.

Hos DinnerdeLuxe leverer vi madoplevelser, der samler mennesker. Vores kantiner er dynamiske samlingspunkter, hvor smag, variation og høj kvalitet er i centrum.

Som køkkenchef er du med til at sætte retningen for både maden og samarbejdet. Du får ansvar for et team på tre medarbejdere og for at skabe en hverdag med høj kvalitet, godt overblik og plads til fællesskab.

Du har det overordnede ansvar for drift, økonomi og ledelse i tæt samarbejde med vores drifts- og kundechef. Det giver dig mulighed for at omsætte dine idéer til madoplevelser, der fungerer i praksis – og få både køkkenets hverdag og budgettet til at hænge sammen.

Vi drømmer om, at du:

·         Har mindst tre års ledelseserfaring og erfaring med at motivere og udvikle et team – gerne fra kantine, catering eller et større køkken.

·         Brænder for at udvikle lækre, varierede menuer.

·         Har god erfaring med vegetarmad og tænker kreativt i plantebaserede retter.

·         Har stærke kompetencer inden for økonomistyring og kan balancere drift, budget og administration.

·         Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket, når der er gang i køkkenet.

·         Prioriterer sundhed og bæredygtighed i dit køkkenarbejde.

Klar til at sætte dit præg på køkkenet?

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til os på job@dinnerdeluxe.dk. Skriv ”Køkkenchef HF-VUC” i emnefeltet.

Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte HR-chef Mette Otto-Werner på job@dinnerdeluxe.dk eller tlf. 25 28 28 76.

Grib muligheden for at blive en del af teamet – vi glæder os helt utroligt meget til at høre fra dig.

Grundet GDPR skal du være opmærksom på, at ansøgninger kun kan sendes til ovenstående mailadresse. Oplys kun de nødvendige personoplysninger som navn, telefonnummer og mailadresse, så vi kan kontakte dig ved spørgsmål eller tilbud om samtale.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Software engineering background
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced Data / Software Engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems and wants to work with modern cloud and data platforms for exciting clients across Stockholm

We’re looking for someone who can move comfortably between software engineering, data engineering, cloud architecture and distributed systems — designing solutions that are scalable, reliable and maintainable in real production environments.

What you'll work with

As a consultant at SwedQ, you'll work closely with engineering and product teams to design and build modern data-intensive systems. Depending on the assignment, that could mean building event-driven platforms, designing data architectures, developing backend services, improving large-scale data processing, or helping teams make better architectural decisions.

For this specific position, we are looking for someone with significant exposure to the Google Cloud platform and services such as:

    

BigQuery

    

Pub/Sub

    

Dataflow / Apache Beam

    

Dataproc / Spark

    

Cloud Storage

    

Cloud Run and GKE

    

Cloud SQL / Spanner

    

Vertex AI and the broader GCP data ecosystem

Beyond experience with individual cloud services, we value an understanding of the principles behind them and an interest in exploring different technologies and architectural approaches

That might include technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, Kubernetes, Snowflake, Databticks, dbt, Airflow, terraform or equivalent services across cloud providers.

What we're looking for

You have a strong software engineering foundation and several years of experience building production systems.

You're comfortable discussing topics such as distributed systems, scalability, event-driven architectures, batch vs. streaming, data modelling, storage technologies, APIs, observability, reliability and cloud infrastructure.

You probably have strong experience with Python, Java, Go, Kotlin, Scala or another modern engineering language, and you're comfortable working with SQL when solving data-intensive problems.

As a consultant

Technical ability matters, but consulting requires more than writing good code.

You'll work directly with clients, understand their problems, challenge assumptions when necessary and turn ambiguous requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.

We therefore value people who:

    

Communicate technical concepts clearly

    

Enjoy collaborating with both engineers and stakeholders

    

Take ownership from problem to production

    

Are curious and continuously explore new technologies

    

Can balance technical excellence with business needs

    

Enjoy sharing knowledge and helping other engineers grow

Why join us?

At SwedQ, we’re an international team with people from different backgrounds, cultures and experiences — and we believe that makes us stronger, both as engineers and as a company.

We work with ambitious companies at the forefront of technology, giving you the opportunity to take on challenging projects, explore modern technologies and continue developing in the direction that interests you.

But work is only part of it. We genuinely enjoy spending time together — whether it’s after-work activities, trips, sports, dinners, gaming or just finding an excuse to have some fun as a team.

Most importantly, we listen to our consultants. We want to understand what motivates you, what you want to learn and where you want your career to go. Your interests and ambitions matter when we look at projects and opportunities.

We want SwedQ to be a place where you can grow professionally, work with great people and have a good time along the way.

jobs.title: Lead Project Leader - AWS AI

jobs.description:
Job ID: 6456

Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced AWS AI Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery and governance of Nordea’s AWS-based AI platform initiatives.

In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional delivery across AWS cloud foundations, AI platform capabilities, security, data and engineering. You will help establish governed, scalable and reusable services that enable AI use cases across Nordea, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory and operational requirements.

You will translate strategic AI and cloud ambitions into executable plans, coordinate dependencies across multiple technology domains and provide clear, transparent reporting to senior stakeholders.

About our team

Core Technology Change & Delivery team is responsible for the Project & Programme management, the delivery & execution and governance of our Change Initiatives  to ensure we meet our commitments in adherence to our Core Tech Operating Model and according to Nordea Delivery Guide.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Lead end-to-end delivery of AWS AI platform initiatives, from scope definition and planning through implementation, operational readiness and handover.
    Establish and maintain delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.
    Coordinate delivery across cloud engineering, architecture, security, identity and access management, network, data, platform engineering and business teams.
    Drive the evolution of AWS cloud foundations required for scalable AI adoption, including landing-zone capabilities, deployment pipelines, runtime environments, connectivity and platform resilience.
    Enable reusable AWS AI services and platform components that support multiple AI use cases and teams across the organisation.
    Ensure alignment between business needs, AI use cases, platform capabilities, enterprise architecture and technology roadmaps.
    Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.
    Establish clear decision-making forums, delivery standards, operating models and reporting practices.
    Proactively manage delivery risks, issues and cross-domain dependencies, escalating when required to maintain predictable execution.
    Drive operational readiness, including support models, service ownership, resilience, security, cost management and transition to operations.
    Engage senior stakeholders and provide concise, decision-oriented updates on delivery status, risks, financials and required actions.
    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Who you are

Your background and skills include:

    Proven track record of leading complex technology programmes in AWS Cloud environments.
    Strong experience in AWS platform governance, cloud operating models, landing-zone implementation and platform evolution.
    Ability to scope, drive and govern AWS AI platform initiatives that provide reusable capabilities for scalable AI adoption.
    Experience leading delivery of AWS-native AI, machine learning and data services, with a clear understanding of how platform capabilities enable business use cases.
    Strong understanding of AI enablement platforms, including Generative AI, large language models, agentic or orchestration frameworks and model lifecycle management.
    Experience coordinating delivery across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data and platform teams.
    Ability to translate AI and AWS platform roadmaps into executable programmes, milestones and delivery plans.
    Strong understanding of platform-oriented delivery, including shared services, reusable components, automated onboarding and self-service capabilities.
    Experience establishing governance frameworks, delivery standards and operating models for large-scale cloud transformations.
    Understanding of cloud security, resilience, scalability, operational excellence and cost-management principles.
    Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders, facilitate decisions and influence cross-functional teams.
    Very good financial, resource, risk and dependency-management skills.
    Very good analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and actions.
    Advanced presentation and reporting skills, particularly using PowerPoint and Excel.
    Excellent communication skills and the ability to bring clarity in both written and verbal communication.
    Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
    A proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented attitude.

The role is specifically positioned around Nordea’s AWS AI platform rather than generic multi-cloud delivery. This is consistent with the planned AWS capabilities for enterprise-scale AI adoption and the current focus on a governed, scalable platform supporting AWS ecosystems.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellows in Educational Measurement
jobs.description:
Job description

Applications are invited for 1-2 full time positions for three- to four-years as Postdoctoral Fellows at the Centre for Research on Equality in Education (CREATE), Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo, Norway. The positions have a double affiliation with the Centre for Educational Measurement (CEMO).

CREATE is an interdisciplinary Centre of Excellence funded by the Research Council of Norway with the objective to generate novel knowledge about how to reduce inequalities in education. The interdisciplinary center integrates researchers with substantive expertise from education, psychology, sociology, economics, and genetics, and methodological expertise from educational measurement, psychometrics, econometrics, statistics, and biostatistics. The Postdoctoral Fellowships are affiliated with CREATE’s research strand 3 «Addressing key methodological challenges».  

CEMO provides a stimulating research environment by bringing internationally renowned substantive and methodological experts together. Research at CEMO combines basic research and applications of advanced measurement techniques to solve core educational problems. CEMO also contributes to the development of measurement competence through teaching and outreach.


More about the positions

The positions are tied to strand 3 of CREATE, which aims to develop novel methods and statistical software that are tailor-made to the research questions and data of CREATE. 

The successful candidate will conduct advanced methodological and psychometric research. Potential research areas include (a) instructional sensitivity and opportunity to learn in international large-scale assessments in education, (b) estimation and inference methods for weighted generalized structural equation models with mixed continuous and discrete data in longitudinal settings, and (c) advancing research synthesis and meta-analytic methods, for instance, to investigate digital inequalities in education using international large-scale assessment data.

The appointments are full-time positions and made for a period of three years, 10% of which is devoted to required duties, usually in the form of teaching activities. If there is a good match between the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs at CEMO, the positions may be extended to four years, 25% of which is devoted to required duties, usually in the form of teaching activities and supervision. For these positions, the teaching activities will be part of CEMO’s master’s programme in Assessment, Measurement and Evaluation.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in one of the social and behavioral sciences, statistics, or computer science applying and/or developing advanced quantitative methods. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
  • Demonstrated fit to one of the three research areas (a) to (c) listed above
  • Proficiency in programming and data analysis in the statistical software environment R, Python, or other relevant programming languages, as evidenced in relevant courses or publication(s)

Applicants will be evaluated as a function of the fit between their qualifications and the research area they apply for. The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

  • For research area (a), prior experience with IRT/mixed-effects logistic regression and international large-scale assessments in education
  • For research area (b), prior experience with latent variable models and Monte Carlo simulation studies
  • For research area (c), prior experience with meta-analysis/research synthesis and international large-scale assessment data

Personal skills
  • Creativity and ability to work independently 
  • Self-motivated, eager to learn and ready to tackle and deal with challenges
  • Able to collaborate with others 

Personal suitability and motivation for the position will be emphasized.


We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Salary NOK 595 000 - 670 000 per annum depending on qualifications in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (position code 1352). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • A professionally stimulating work environment
  • An interdisciplinary and international work environment, recognized as a Centre of Excellence
  • Attractive welfare benefits 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (maximum two pages), including a statement of motivation and your fit with one of the research areas (a) to (c) listed above 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copy of PhD Diploma or documentation of thesis submission. Applicants who have not yet defended their PhD dissertation need to include an advisor's letter confirming specific expectations about when the degree will be received
  • Copy of the PhD thesis 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • A complete list of publications
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their University's grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

Incomplete applications will not be assessed. 

In assessing the applicants, special emphasis will be placed on the documented, academic qualifications, as well as the candidates motivation and personal suitability. Interviews with the best qualified candidates will be arranged.

It is expected that the successful candidate will be able to complete the project in the course of the period of employment.


Formal regulations

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral Fellowships at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Fellow period at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

CREATE (Centre of Research on Equality in Education) is an interdisciplinary Centre of Excellence funded by the Research Council of Norway and the Faculty of Educational Sciences. CREATE’s objective is to generate novel knowledge about how to reduce inequalities in education.

jobs.title: Regionshospitalet Gødstrup – Chefjordemoder, Kvindesygdomme og Fødsler
jobs.description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for et af landets mest anerkendte fødesteder – og være med til at sikre stærk faglig kvalitet, bæredygtige arbejdsliv og udvikling i kvindesundhed? Så er du måske vores nye chefjordemoder.

 

Et lederskab med betydning

Som chefjordemoder hos os får du, sammen med cheflægen, ansvaret for ledelse og udvikling i en afdeling, hvor sikkerhed, atmosfære og relationer danner rammer om både de gode patientforløb og om medarbejdernes trivsel.

Du kommer til at spille en central rolle i at videreudvikle vores stærke faglige miljø i en afdeling, der hvert år håndterer ca. 3200 fødsler – og som af Dagens Medicin er kåret som Danmarks bedste fødeafdeling ni år i træk på baggrund af bl.a. en systematisk arbejdsindsats for løbende at udvikle vores kvalitet. Samtidig har vi stærke ambitioner om at fastholde vores position som frontløber for den attraktive og bæredygtige arbejdsplads, hvor vi bl.a. har udfordret vanetænkning og rammer og bl.a. givet os 4 dages arbejdsuge og flexjordemødre.

 

 

Om stillingen 
Som afdelingsleder refererer du til sundheds- og hospitalsledelsen, og du bliver en del af en afdelingsledelseskreds, som har et stærkt fællesskab, og som hjælper, inspirerer og lærer af hinanden. Vi er optaget af transformation, involvering og bæredygtig ledelse og har fokus på at udvikle sundhedstilbud tættere på borgerne og i sammenhæng med centrale sundhedsaktører. 

Vi ser ind i en sundhedsreform, der åbner for nye muligheder for også at udvikle graviditets-, fødsels- og barselsområdet på tværs af hospital, kommuner og de almenmedicinske tilbud. Som chefjordemoder bliver du en del af en ledelsesgruppe, der er optaget af, hvordan kurs, koordinering og kommittent bliver en drivkraft i udviklingen af den faglighed og innovation, der er grundpillerne for et udadvendt hospital, der aktivt bidrager til at forme fremtidens sundhedslandskab i Sundhedsområde Vestjylland med borgerne i centrum. 
 
Du vil være en synlig leder, der skaber retning og følgeskab gennem dialog, tillid og tydelig kommunikation. Du vil samle fagligheder, kommuner, sundhedspleje, almenmedicin og civilsamfund om at skabe de bedst mulige forløb før, under og efter fødslen. I tværsektorielt samarbejde nytænker I arbejdsgange og organisering, så flere tilbud kommer tættere på familierne. Din opgave er at omsætte reformens ambitioner om nærhed, tilgængelig og lighed i sundhed til konkrete forbedringer, som familierne mærker gennem høj kvalitet, koordineret overgange og sammenhængende forløb. 

I vores tilgang til ledelse går vi til vores opgave, rolle og ansvar med blik for helheden for både kerneopgave, medarbejdere, patienter, borger og dets pårørende. Vi vil lykkes gennem en samarbejdskultur og forvalter vores afdelingsledelse i et sideordnet fællesskab mellem chefjordemoderen og cheflægen. Sammen har I ansvaret for den strategiske udvikling, faglige retning og daglige drift af afdelingen i tæt samarbejde med den samlede ledergruppe. 


Samtidig forventes du at bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af specialet både regionalt og nationalt, og du vil foruden ledelsen ind i den daglige drift være med til at lede udviklingen af en afdeling i et sundhedsvæsen under forandring. Sundhedsreformen skal omsættes til konkrete faglige og organisatoriske prioriteringer, som styrker kvalitet, tilgængelighed og sammenhæng for familierne på tværs af kommuner, almenmedicin og hospital. Det stiller krav til et stærkt tværsektorielt samarbejde og evnen til at skabe retning og fremdrift i en tid med forandring. Samtidig giver udviklingen en mulighed for at nytænke arbejdsgange, organisering og nye innovative løsninger sådan, at flere tilbud kan bringes tættere på borgerne og fremtidens sammenhængende familieforløb kan udvikles på tværs af geografi og sektorer.

Stillingen indebærer bl.a. ansvar for at: 

  • sætte en tydelig strategisk retning for afdelingens udvikling 
  • styrke det tværfaglige samarbejde i og omkring afdelingen 
  • udøve strategisk og faglig ledelse af graviditet, fødsel og barsel, samt kvindesygdomme
  • udvikle et attraktivt og bæredygtigt arbejdsmiljø for både ledere og medarbejdere
  • kvalitetssikring og faglig udvikling i hele svangreomsorgen, både internt og i tæt samarbejde med de ledende sundhedsplejersker i vores 6 kommuner
  • medansvar for optimal ressourceudnyttelse og planlægning
  • fortsat udvikling af vores lærings- og forbedringskultur

 

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Et solidt fagligt og organisatorisk fundament at bygge videre på
  • En engageret medarbejdergruppe, som brænder for deres fag
  • En ledergruppe, hvor samarbejde, inspiration, mod og hjælpsomhed er nøgleord

Da vi søger en chefjordemoder, der sammen med cheflægen kan samle mennesker om en fælles ambition og skabe udvikling gennem dialog, skal du have lyst til at være synlig, nysgerrig og nærværende i hverdagen og samtidig kunne navigere i et sundhedsvæsen under forandring. Som chefjordemoder får du en unik mulighed for at samle fagligheder, kommuner og samarbejdspartnere om at skabe de bedst mulige forløb for familierne. 

Der er mulighed for at deltage i klinisk arbejde i det omfang, lederopgaven tillader det

 

Din profil og ledelsesværdier

  • Du er uddannet jordemoder
  • Du har ledelseserfaring, der matcher stillingen – gerne suppleret med relevant ledelsesmæssig uddannelse
  • Du har erfaring med eller interesse for strategisk ledelse i en kompleks organisation og blik for sundhedspolitiske beslutningers betydning for afdelingens fremtidige arbejde
  • Du formår at skabe et samarbejdsrum, hvor vi deler perspektiver, koordinerer forståelse, aktiverer viden og lærer af vores fejl
  • Du skaber retning ved at involvere, finde løsninger sammen og etablere følge- og ejerskab
  • Du formår at skabe trivsel gennem åbenhed, tillid og gensidig forventningsafstemning
  • Du er garant for ordentlighed og har mod til at vise sårbarhed og være i proces
  • Du har et positivt mindset, der smitter af på omgivelserne
  • Du motiveres af at levere resultater og kvalitet på et højt fagligt niveau i et miljø, hvor den gode arbejdsplads skabes i fællesskab   

Se stillings- og funktionsbeskrivelse her

Mere om afdelingen

Kvindesygdomme og Fødsler varetager opgaverne i moderne rammer, hvor fødegang, akutklinik, barsel, jordemoderkonsultationer, sekretariat, familieambulatorium og klinik for gravide – er samlet i ”Familieklyngen”. Her har vi fokus på at skabe sammenhængende forløb for familierne, og på at alle medarbejdere oplever faglig sparring, læring og udvikling i hverdagen.

 

Vi har stærke værdier: Sikkerhed, Atmosfære og Relationer som du vil mærke og opleve bl.a. som: 

  • Sikkerhed i form af høj kvalitet og en vedholdende, systematisk indsats for at forbedre vores kvalitet
  • En atmosfære med helt unikt fødemiljø med både interaktive fødestuer, barselsstuer med dobbeltseng med plads til partner og arbejde med lyddesign. Atmosfære handler også om den stemning, vi skaber både sammen med parrene og blandt kollegaer.
  • Relationer i kraft af arbejdet med 4 kendte jordemoderordninger, fordi vi tror på, at kontinuitet og kendthed har stor betydning for parrenes tryghed og oplevelse.

 

 

Praktiske oplysninger

Læs mere om afdelingen her: Kvindesygdomme og Fødsler - Fagperson Regionshospitalet Gødstrup.

 

Vil du vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte chefjordemoder Charlotte Sander Andersen, tlf. 2381 7653 eller sygeplejefaglig direktør Rikke Degn, tlf. 2819 4002.

 

Du kan søge jobbet online ved at klikke på ”Ansøg”. Vedhæft din ansøgning og dit CV. 

 

Ansøgningen skal være os i hænde senest den 3. november 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler afvikles den 12. november 2026. Anden samtale afvikles den 23. november 2026.

Der anvendes personprofil i ansættelsesprocessen med tilbagemelding i uge 47, ligesom der til samtalerne indgår en skriftlig case med lidt forberedelsestid.

 

Ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027 eller efter nærmere aftale. 

Ansættelse er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børneattest. 

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.title: Landbrugsmedhjælper
jobs.description:
Experienced Milker Wanted for a Modern Jersey Dairy Farm in North Jutland

Would you like to be part of a workplace built on respect, teamwork, and professionalism?

A well-managed dairy farm near Vrå (9760) is looking for an experienced employee for milking and other barn-related tasks. The farm has been operated with great passion and professional expertise for more than 42 years and has built a strong workplace culture where employees support one another, show mutual respect, and share responsibility for the daily work.

The farm is home to approximately 900 Jersey cows and operates with modern facilities and well-established routines that ensure high animal welfare standards and a positive working environment.

About the Position

We are looking for a new team member to strengthen the workforce and help maintain the high standards of daily operations.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Milking in a modern 60-point rotary milking parlor
  • Bedding cubicles
  • Washing and cleaning
  • General barn duties

Three employees are involved in the milking operation, and tasks are rotated according to a schedule, providing variety throughout the working week.

Working Hours

Milking takes place:

  • 03:00 - 08:00
  • 15:00 - 19:30

Weekend work is included according to a rotating schedule.

Typically, you will:

  • Work both morning and afternoon milking shifts 1-2 times per week
  • Work only one shift per day during the remaining weekdays

There is a shared morning coffee break at 08:00, where colleagues meet and coordinate the day's tasks.

Who Are You?

We expect that you:

  • Have experience milking dairy cows
  • Speak and understand English
  • Have an interest in dairy farming and agriculture
  • Thrive in a structured work environment with routines and responsibilities
  • Are reliable and flexible
  • Are friendly and team-oriented
  • Take initiative and approach challenges with a solutions-focused mindset

A driver's license is not required.

We Offer

  • Permanent employment with the possibility of many years of service
  • Competitive salary based on qualifications
  • A stable and professionally managed workplace with 42 years of experience
  • An international working environment with both Danish and foreign colleagues
  • Supportive colleagues who help one another
  • A workplace where respect, cooperation, and professionalism are a natural part of everyday life

The team currently consists of approximately 20 employees, including colleagues from Denmark, Ukraine, Kyrgyzstan, and Eritrea.

Please contact Tetiana if you want more information. The job is as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Lindevangskolen søger pædagog til vores specialrække
jobs.description:
Pædagog med hjerte og høj faglighed til vores specialrække – Bliv en del af et stærkt hold med store frihed under ansvar.

Drømmer du om en hverdag med frihed under ansvar, står indflydelse og reel medbestemmelse? Vil du være med til at præge retningen og bruge din pædagogiske faglighed i et stærkt og hjertevarmt team, hvor dine idéer bliver til virkelighed? Vil du indgå i en arbejdsplads hvor du får lov til at være noget for nogen?

Så er det måske dig, vi mangler i vores special række på Lindevangskolen.

Vi søger en pædagog, som brænder for specialområdet, der er forankret i sin faglighed, tør tænke ud af boksen og som vil have reel og direkte indflydelse på vores dagligdag og samt udvikling af vores praksis.

Stillingen er på 37 timer og er til besættelse hurtigst muligt.

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en specialrække på en almen folkeskole, med børn fra børnehaveklassen til og med 6. klasse. Vi er en arbejdsplads, hvor der er kort vej fra tanke til handling og hvor vi vægter frihed under ansvar højt.

Vi lægger ikke skjul på at specialområdet kan være krævende, med en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor tempoet ofte er højt, men hos os står du aldrig alene. Vi prioriterer fast faglig sparring, et tæt makkerskab og et arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til grin og gode ideer.

Hverdagen hos os

Hos os arbejder vi med børn med og uden diagnoser. Fællers for dem alle er dog at de har brug for en ekstra tydelig struktur, forudsigelighed og specialpædagogisk støtte for at kunne trives og udvikle sig. Din hverdag kommer til at veksle mellem:

  • At skabe faste, trygge rammer og genkendelige rutiner for børnegruppen.
  • At understøtte og udvikle sociale kompetencer og trivsel i både undervisningsmiljøet, frikvartererne og SFO-tiden.
  • Have teten på pædagogiske aktiviteter. Dette både inde og ude. I gymnastiksalen, musik eller sløjdlokalet, i svømmehallen eller når vi er på tur med eller uden vores minibus. Eller hvad Du måtte brænde for.
  • Mægle i konflikter og have øje for det forebyggende pædagogiske arbejde, for at disse ikke opstår.
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med lærer, ledelse, forældre PPR, videncenteret og andre relevante samarbejdspartnere.
  • At omsætte egne pædagogiske ideer til praksis. Har du en god ide til pædagogiske aktiviteter, indretning eller lignende er der højt til loftet og opbakning til at prøve det af.
  • To faste ugentlige møder. Et i pædagoggruppen og et i dit klasseteam

Hvem er du

V forestiller os, at du er:

  • Uddannet pædagog- gerne med erfaring fra eller et brændende hjerte for specialområdet
  • Hviler i dig selv, udstråler ro og kan fungere som et trygt anker for børn, der kan have brug for tydelige voksne
  • Trives med frihed under ansvar, tør tage initiativ og gå nysgerrig til værks.
  • Er god til at skabe tillidsfulde relationer – både til børnene, forældrene og dine kollegaer
  • Ser ressourcer bag udfordringerne og kan møde børnene med anerkendelse, tålmodighed, forståelse og et smil.

Kom og hils på

Er du nysgerrig efter at høre mere, eller har lyst til at kigge forbi til en kop kaffe og en uforpligtigende rundvisning, før du sender din ansøgning? Så tæv ikke med at kontakte Peter eller Lasse på 28980783

jobs.title: Marketing Manager B2B Telecom SaaS
jobs.description:
VX Fiber | Stockholm | Full-time

VX Fiber is looking for an experienced, hands-on Marketing Manager to take ownership of our marketing and help us generate more qualified sales opportunities across our international markets.

You will turn commercial priorities into a focused marketing plan—and deliver it. From sharpening our product messaging and creating campaigns to building HubSpot workflows and improving our website, you will combine sound marketing judgement with practical execution.

As our main marketing owner, you will work closely with sales, product, leadership, agencies and marketing specialists.

The role

This role suits someone who enjoys both deciding what needs to happen and making it happen. You can identify the right audiences, explain a complex technology offering clearly, and build campaigns that move potential customers from initial interest to a meaningful sales conversation, experirence in technology marketing and ideally B2B telecommunicaitons is highly valued.

You will have ownership of marketing planning, delivery and improvement, with the opportunity to shape how marketing develops at VX Fiber.

What you’ll do

    Own the marketing plan. Translate business and sales priorities into clear audiences, campaigns, budgets and measurable objectives. Make deliberate choices about where to focus time and resources.
    Generate qualified demand. Plan, build and improve campaigns across our website, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels, taking responsibility for the content and execution.
    Work closely with sales. Agree target customers, qualification criteria and follow-up processes. Use feedback from sales conversations to improve targeting, messaging and lead quality.
    Lead product and solution messaging. Turn technical capabilities, customer insights and commercial benefits into clear positioning for network owners, service providers and other relevant buyers.
    Improve our website and content. Create and maintain product pages, campaign pages, customer stories and clear calls to action that help visitors understand our offer and take the next step.
    Equip sales with useful materials. Develop presentations, one-pagers, case studies and campaign assets that support customer conversations and help opportunities progress.
    Measure performance and act on it. Track conversion, lead quality, opportunities and marketing’s contribution to pipeline. Use the findings to improve campaigns and guide investment.
    Manage external support. Brief and coordinate agencies or freelancers, manage agreed budgets, and maintain quality and consistency across their work.

What you’ll bring

    Typically five or more years of relevant B2B marketing experience, with a track record of owning and delivering marketing activity.
    Evidence of generating qualified demand and supporting sales pipeline, with the ability to explain what you delivered and what changed as a result.
    Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform.
    Strong writing and editing skills, including the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, commercially relevant content.
    Practical experience with digital campaigns, website content, email marketing and LinkedIn.
    Confidence working with sales, product specialists and senior leadership, including challenging assumptions and recommending priorities.
    The judgement to balance ambition with available resources, and the willingness to produce work yourself.
    Fluent English. Swedish is a strong advantage, and additional languages are welcome.

Experience in B2B technology, telecoms, fibre, infrastructure, SaaS or connectivity would be particularly valuable. Familiarity with longer sales cycles, account-based marketing and managing external specialists would also be an advantage.

Why join VX Fiber?

You will have real ownership, close collaboration with colleagues across the business, and the opportunity to make a visible commercial contribution.

You’ll work in an international environment, helping customers understand technology that supports reliable connectivity and the development of digital infrastructure.

Practical details

    Employment: Permanent, full-time.
    Location: Based in Stockholm.
    Work eligibility: You must have the right to work in Sweden.
    Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

About VX Fiber

VX Fiber enables fiber network owners and service providers to consolidate, automate, and scale operations and wholesale business models.

Founded in Sweden during the early development of open access fiber network build, now with over 20 years of operations, service delivery and software development experience, we deliver an OSS/BSS SaaS platform, engineering services and operational services.

jobs.title: Postdoctor position available to study carbon assimilation in trees
jobs.description:
Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology

The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.

About the position

A post-doctoral position is available in the http://www.upsc.se/totte_niittyla at the Umeå Plant Science Center, Sweden to study carbon assimilation in trees using aspen as the model system. The position is part of a Swedish Research Council and NovoNordisk Synergy Projects. The latter is a collaboration between the Niittylä group, the https://cbmr.ku.dk/research/research-groups/moritz-group/?pure=en/persons/643429) at the University of Copenhagen and the https://www.helsinki.fi/en/researchgroups/plant-growth-dynamics at the University of Helsinki.

Trees represent the single most important carbon sink on the planet. An incomplete mechanistic understanding of carbon sequestration limits our ability of predict the capacity of trees to assimilate CO2 and optimise the production of sustainable wood derived materials and fuels. The project will adress this problem by investigating the connection between photosynthesis and downstream metabolic fluxes in leaves using a set of aspen mutants and isotope techniques.

The postdoc will collaborate between the three research groups, and will have the opportunity to pitch additional projects and integrate their own interests.

Your profile

Applicants should have a PhD in plant molecular biology, plant biochemistry or plant physiology. Biochemistry skills are important and previous experience on photosynthesis acclimation research in trees and Populus model systems are highly desirable.

English fluency and publication in peer-reviewed high-quality journal(s) is required.

As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most.

About us

UPSC belongs to two universities, the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences and Umeå University. About 200 people from more than 40 different nationalities work here. We host some 30 principal investigators, and our researchers have access to state-of-the-art analytical platforms, unique tree germplasm resources and plant growth facilities. We strive for a collaborative work environment and support our scientists throughout all career stages by providing professional training opportunities and individual career mentoring.

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location:

Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology, SLU, Umeå.

Form of employment:

Temporary employment 24 months, with the possibility of extension depending on funding and project progress.

Scope:

100%

Start date:

January 2027 or as agreed.

Application:

The application should include a letter of interest detailing research experience, achievements and publications and curriculum vitae.

Please submit your application before deadline 21 October 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

Union representatives:

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/





The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

  • gerne har erfaring som kirketjener eller fra en lignende stilling

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

·       The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently

·       The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers

·       The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages

·       The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications

·       A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

·       A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development

·       A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group

·       Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation

·       Good opportunities for both professional and personal development

·       Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance

·       A good canteen scheme and active staff association

·       An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.
