Qui sommes-nous ? 

 

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. 

 

 

Vos missions : 

 

Rattaché.e au Responsable Asset Management and O&M, vous aurez pour objectifs d'analyser les performances des centrales éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage et d'en garantir la fiabilité des données. 

 

Vos missions principales seront :  

 

  • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires d’actifs (Asset Managers) pour suivre et analyser les performances des parcs éoliens, photovoltaïques et des systèmes de stockage en exploitation.  
  • Garantir l’intégrité des données collectées, les analyser et les partager afin d’assurer une gestion efficace des tableaux de bord.  
  • Travailler avec les différents départements de Q ENERGY afin d’optimiser la rentabilité de nos projets éoliens, solaires et de stockage ainsi que la performance des centrales.  
  • Mettre en place des tableaux de bord automatisés à destination des parties prenantes.  
  • Administrer les bases de données et exploiter les outils MySQL et Power BI.  
  • Assurer le support dans la gestion quotidienne des données ainsi que dans la création des politiques et autorisations d’accès.  
  • Être responsable de l’historisation SCADA et des plateformes de supervision.  
  • Assurer la supervision des systèmes SCADA et des réseaux, réaliser les diagnostics SCADA, détecter les anomalies et les corriger pendant la phase d’exploitation.  
  • Être le référent technique pour toutes les questions liées au SCADA et à la gestion des installations éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage en exploitation.  
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Développement, Achats et Construction afin d’améliorer les outils de suivi et de partager les bonnes pratiques.  
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue : fiabilité des installations, animation de groupes de travail.  
  • Assurer le suivi des obligations contractuelles du prestataire SCADA en phase d’exploitation. 

 

 

HSE : 

 

Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via :  

 

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides 
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement  
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques 

  

 

 

 

Qualité : 

 

  • Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité  
  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité  
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives 
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs 

Requirements

Votre profil : 

De formation ingénieur généraliste, vous disposez de solides compétences techniques et aimez évoluer dans des environnements à la croisée de plusieurs expertises. 

Vous avez notamment de bonnes connaissances en automatisme, ainsi qu’en informatique et réseaux de communication. Des bases en électricité HT/BT vous permettent également de comprendre les principaux enjeux techniques liés aux installations. 

À l’aise dans les échanges, vous êtes reconnu.e pour vos qualités de communication, votre esprit d’équipe et votre capacité à travailler de manière autonome. Vous savez également prendre des décisions rapidement lorsque la situation l’exige. 

Un bon niveau d’anglais technique est attendu afin de pouvoir évoluer dans un environnement professionnel international. 

Une première expérience dans le secteur des énergies renouvelables serait un véritable atout, mais c’est avant tout votre curiosité, votre autonomie et votre envie de relever des défis techniques qui feront la différence ! 

 

Localisation et déplacements : 

Le poste implique des déplacements réguliers sur les différents sites de l’entreprise à travers la France, représentant environ 25 % du temps de travail. 

Vous êtes donc mobile et appréciez le fait de pouvoir alterner entre travail au bureau et interventions directement sur le terrain.

Benefits

Comment faisons-nous la différence ? 

  • Des valeurs fortes et incarnées   
  • Un management de proximité   
  • Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante   
  • Une entreprise en constant développement  
  • Valorisation et développement des compétences   

 

 

 

Nos avantages sociaux 

  • Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires 
  • 4 jours de congés par an offerts pour des actions de bénévolat    
  • L’abondement de vos dons aux associations à hauteur de 500€ par an    
  • Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité  
  • Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société)   
  • Activités et évènements régulièrement proposés par le CSE   
  • Très bonne couverture mutuelle (famille incluse) et Prévoyance    

 

Nous concourrons à créer un environnement professionnel fondé sur le respect, l'inclusion et la bienveillance, en réunissant des personnes d'horizons différents pour qu'elles nous apportent des idées novatrices et de nouvelles perspectives. 

Convaincu.e.s que la diversité est une richesse, nous veillons à offrir un processus de recrutement accessible et équitable. A compétences égales, toutes les candidatures sont étudiées avec la même attention. jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.description:
Work tasks: Automotive and Furniture Upholstery Sewer
(working with genuine leather, faux leather, heavy upholstery fabrics, and Alcantara, and operating heavy-duty industrial machinery). Job Responsibilities ￼ Sewing automotive interior components: Sewing car seat covers, headrests, armrests, door panels, steering wheel covers, headliners, and gear shift/handbrake gaiters. ￼ Creating patterns and templates: Dismantling old covers, assessing wear, and deriving precise new patterns based on them. ￼ Decorative stitching: Executing design stitching (e.g., diamond quilting, double stitching with contrasting thread) and decorative piping. ￼ Adhering to safety requirements: Creating special breakaway safety seams for airbag-equipped seats in accordance with manufacturer standards. ￼ Processing specialized materials: Selecting leather, culling defective pieces, and precision edge thinning (skiving) prior to assembly. ￼ Sewing furniture and cushion covers: Sewing covers for sofas, armchairs, chair seats, headboards, office furniture, and decorative cushions. ￼ Pattern matching and cutting: Precisely positioning and aligning fabric patterns (stripes, checks, large decorative motifs) across different components. ￼ Preparation of edge bindings and piping: Sewing in edge treatments designed to reinforce and decorate furniture edges. ￼ Installation of hardware and fasteners: Sewing on zippers, Velcro strips, buttons, and fastening strips that allow covers to be removed or stretched tight over the frame. ￼ Collaboration with the upholsterer: Checking the fit of covers on the furniture frame and making adjustments if necessary before final stapling. ￼ Material usage planning: Optimizing the layout of fabrics and leathers during cutting to minimize material waste.

We offer: Bee Interior (specializing in exclusive upholstery and interior work for vehicles, watercraft, and furniture) typically offers the following conditions and benefits to its automotive and furniture upholsterers:
Exciting and varied projects: The work is not assembly-line production—every project is unique, ranging from interiors for vintage and luxury cars to motorcycle seats and custom-made furniture. ￼ Competitive pay commensurate with skills ￼ Professional tools and equipment ￼ On-site training and specialization: Support and guidance in executing specific cutting techniques, decorative stitching, and leather preparation. ￼ Stable full-time employment: Long-term job security and a steady workload in a specialized craft sector. ￼ Pleasant work environment: A small, professional, and supportive team that values ​​high-quality craftsmanship.

Option to work from home: No

Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.
- Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Open and close the restaurant in accordance with approved Company procedures and checklists, ensuring that all required opening and closing tasks are properly and fully completed. - Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. - Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. - Guide, supervise, train, and support servers and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. - Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth restaurant operations. - Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. - Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. - Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. - Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. - Manage and participate in continuous improvement of operations. Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Trustworthy, responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

jobs.title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

  • Direction. The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
  • Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
  • Organisation. Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
  • Leaders. Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
  • Quality. Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
  • Product interface. What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.


Your profile

You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention.

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services.
  • 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you.
  • Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage.
  • You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume.
  • Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built.


Why us?

LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification.

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it.

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like.

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market.

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional.

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Android/Kotlin
jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Location: You can choose to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.

➡️ Mission

Join us as an Android Engineer and help us build the mobile experience that 600,000+ European businesses rely on every day to manage their finances. You'll own product-critical features end-to-end — from technical design to rollout — in a large, modular Kotlin codebase where craft and velocity both matter. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Frontend.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own features end-to-end: You'll take ownership from discovery and technical design through implementation, rollout, and iteration on features that help businesses pay, get paid, and stay in control.
  • Drive technical decisions in your squad: You'll shape solutions with Product, Design, and Backend by clarifying tradeoffs across UX, performance, security, and time-to-market.
  • Raise app reliability and maintainability: You'll improve architecture, performance, and test strategy to scale the app without compromising stability.
  • Tackle complex mobile challenges: You'll contribute to real-time synchronization, resilience patterns, and smooth navigation in a modular codebase with ~1,000 modules.
  • Grow the team's Android craft: You'll lead code reviews and technical discussions, share patterns, and mentor peers to raise the bar on quality and delivery.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Strong Android native experience: You've shipped and maintained production features with Kotlin and are comfortable owning technical decisions end-to-end.
  • Quality-driven mindset: You care about testing (unit, UI, snapshot), clean code, and pragmatic standards that keep teams moving fast.
  • Problem-solving approach: You thrive in ambiguity and turn complex constraints into simple, robust solutions.
  • AI-native workflow: You use AI coding tools daily to amplify your output — not just experiment with them.
  • Collaborative by nature: You're fluent in English and contribute through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • An AI-first engineering environment: Unlimited access to Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot — and a culture that expects you to use them to raise the bar, not just go faster (click here to read our vision statement on AI)
  • Engineering standards that scale: Strong code review culture, continuous refactoring, and a focus on correctness in a regulated context.
  • A technically demanding domain: Fintech constraints — security, compliance, real-time data — push you to solve problems most mobile engineers never encounter.

➡️ Our methodology, the Qonto Way

  • We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing — quality drives the velocity our customers need.
  • Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates.
  • Our lean toolbox, Kaizen and PDCA, lets you monitor and drive continuous improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager.
Want to go further? Click here

  • Kotlin-first & modern concurrency: 100% Kotlin codebase with Coroutines + Flow throughout.

As an Android Engineer, you will join one of Qonto's squad teams, each organised around a clear project mission, with one team lead and full ownership of a product scope. Die collana health AG fungiert als digitales Kompetenzzentrum für das schweizerische Gesundheitswesen.   • Selbstständige und vertrauenswürdige Arbeitsweise mit Verantwortungsübernahme
  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Teamarbeit und Innovationsprojekten
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse (Italienisch und Französisch von Vorteil)


Warum wir?

jobs.title: Barcelona Tvsäljare
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av tv-abonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Security guard
jobs.description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Mechanic, HGV Mechanic or Welder wanted for varied role in Glostrup
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced mechanic or welder who thrives in a varied working environment with a high degree of responsibility? Would you like to work in a small, dynamic team where there is a short path from idea to action? Then you may be the person we are looking for at our workshop in Glostrup.

We are looking for a highly skilled professional with solid experience – preferably someone at senior level – who is able to work independently and take responsibility for both planned maintenance and urgent repairs.

About the Position

You will become part of a dedicated and informal team where collaboration and flexibility are key. We offer a varied working day with a high degree of freedom and responsibility, giving you the opportunity to influence and shape your own tasks.

Our fleet is broad and diverse, meaning you will work with many different types of vehicles and equipment. These include refuse collection vehicles, flatbed and hook-lift trucks, crane trucks, construction trailers, construction machinery and other equipment at our site.

Your tasks will range from troubleshooting and repairs to ongoing maintenance and optimisation. No two days are the same, so it is important that you have a practical approach and enjoy finding solutions to both minor and complex challenges. There may occasionally be overtime, particularly when urgent issues arise and need to be resolved quickly.

Your Qualifications

We imagine that you:

  • Are a qualified welder, mechanic or HGV mechanic

  • Have several years of experience from a similar position

  • Ideally have experience maintaining refuse collection vehicles (not a requirement)

  • Hold a category B and C driving licence, and preferably CE

  • Have knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems

  • Work in a structured and independent manner

  • Are reliable, flexible and responsible

  • Take pride in delivering high-quality work and getting the job done properly the first time

What We Offer

We offer an exciting and varied position in an informal working environment with good colleagues and a friendly atmosphere. You will have opportunities for professional development and the freedom to influence your own working day.

We provide good employment conditions, excellent facilities and a workplace where your contribution is valued. Working hours will be arranged by agreement between Monday and Friday, within the hours of 6:00 am and 6:00 pm.

The position is available as soon as possible, but we are happy to wait for the right candidate.

 Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Dan Andersen on +45 28 45 80 35.

Are you ready for your next step? Submit your application via this link:
https://candidate.hr-manager.net/ApplicationInit.aspx?cid=1035&ProjectId=146122&DepartmentId=18964&MediaId=5

We look forward to hearing from you!

Ensure all company policies and procedures relating to food safety, health & safety, allergens, and hygiene are followed. Requirements: 5 years' professional kitchen experience, with previous Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef or senior Chef de Partie experience Experience in a high-end, fine-dining, luxury hotel or quality restaurant environment. jobs.title: Er du SuperUsers' nye dataspecialist og -instruktør?
jobs.description:
Er du stærk inden for data, og har du lyst til at fordybe dig fagligt, arbejde med nye teknologier inden for data og AI og lære fra dig som kursusinstruktør? Så er du måske vores nye fuldtidskollega!

Vi søger en teknisk stærk og nysgerrig dataperson med et solidt fagligt fundament og lyst til løbende at udvide det. Særligt Databricks, Microsoft Fabric og Python er centrale teknologier i rollen, suppleret af Power BI og SQL som vigtige dele af værktøjskassen. Dataområdet udvikler sig hurtigt i takt med AI, og du vil få mulighed for at arbejde med teknologier og løsninger i krydsfeltet mellem data, analytics og AI.

Undervisningserfaring er ikke et krav. Det er derimod vigtigt, at du har lyst til at formidle, forklare og gøre komplekse tekniske emner forståelige og anvendelige for andre.

Om SuperUsers A/S
SuperUsers er et danskejet IT-kursus- og konsulenthus, stiftet i 1984. Vi er ca. 30 kolleger, der brænder for kurser, læring og kompetenceudvikling inden for bl.a. data, AI, cloud, cybersikkerhed, softwareudvikling og infrastruktur. Vi er bl.a. officiel Microsoft Training Services Partner og samarbejder med en række af branchens førende teknologileverandører.

Du bliver en del af vores team af konsulenter og instruktører, måske Danmarks bedste, når det gælder teknisk undervisning på højt niveau. Fælles for os er, at vi går op i vores fag, følger udviklingen tæt og gerne deler vores viden med både kursister og hinanden.

Vi har afdelinger i både Hillerød og Aarhus. I Hillerød får du din daglige gang på Karlebogaard, en historisk landejendom, hvor vi hver dag byder kursister velkommen på kursus i nogle helt unikke rammer. Her bliver du en del af et fagligt og socialt miljø med ca. 20 kolleger.

Om stillingen som instruktør
Din primære opgave bliver at undervise og afholde tekniske kurser for IT- og datafolk. Du kommer til at arbejde med og undervise inden for vores dataområder og får rig mulighed for løbende at udvide med nye teknologier og fagområder. Vi lægger stor vægt på at følge udviklingen tæt, og du får derfor både tid og mulighed for faglig fordybelse, selvstudie, kurser og sparring med vores øvrige instruktører.

På sigt vil cirka halvdelen af din tid være undervisning. Den øvrige tid vil blandt andet gå med forberedelse, udvikling af kurser og labs, opdatering af undervisningsmateriale, faglig udvikling samt konsulent- og kundeopgaver afhængigt af aktuelle behov.

Dine centrale opgaver bliver bl.a. at:

  • Undervise inden for særligt Databricks, Microsoft Fabric og Python, samt Power BI, SQL og relaterede dataområder.

  • Formidle data engineering, analyse og moderne dataplatforme på en jordnær og anvendelig måde.

  • Udvikle og opdatere kurser, øvelser og undervisningsmateriale, samt sparre med vores øvrige instruktører og konsulenter.

  • Holde dig fagligt opdateret og være med til at vurdere, hvilke nye teknologier vi skal arbejde med, herunder udviklingen inden for AI og samspillet mellem AI, data engineering og moderne dataplatforme.

  • Løse enkelte konsulentopgaver, når de opstår inden for dine fagområder.

  • Lejlighedsvis undervise eller deltage i aktiviteter på vores øvrige lokationer, typisk hver 1.-2. måned.

jobs.title: Vil du være en del af vores stærke pædagogteam i børnehaven i Schous Børnehus?
jobs.description:
Vi er netop i gang med en rivende faglig udvikling i vores børnehave – og nu mangler vi den sidste pædagog på holdet, der sammen med os vil være med til at løfte vores børnehave til næste niveau.

Måske er det dig?

Måske er du optaget af musik og fællessang.
Måske elsker du udeliv, natur og ture ud af huset.
Måske er du god til fortællinger, teater eller til at skabe fantasifulde legeuniverser.

Eller måske er din største styrke, at du møder børn med varme, nærvær og en særlig evne til at få alle med i fællesskabet.

Hos os er der plads til forskellige pædagogiske interesser og kompetencer – for vi tror på, at stærke børnefællesskaber skabes af voksne, der bringer deres faglighed og personlighed i spil.

Schous Børnehus er en selvejende integreret daginstitution midt i Københavns Nordvestkvarter – tæt på både Utterslev Mose, byens liv og kulturtilbud.

jobs.title: Paid Social Specialist – bliv ekspert i én branche
jobs.description:
Hjælp top 1 % med at blive endnu rigere
Fuldtid · Fysisk på kontoret ved Vesterport, København · Start hurtigst muligt

På Vinduespudserskolen starter man typisk som elev, fordi man drømmer om mere frihed i sin hverdag.

Det er helt simpelt. Forestil dig, at vinduespudseren kommer ud til en kunde på det tidspunkt, der passer ham. Han pudser huset hele vejen rundt på 5 minutter, systemet sender automatisk en faktura på 399 kr. til kunden og navigerer ham videre til næste kunde på vejen.

Så kan man selv regne på det. Gør du det én gang om dagen, 22 dage om måneden, har du 8.778 kr. i omsætning. Gør du som de andre, bare 15 gange om dagen, omsætter du for 131.670 kr. om måneden. Og så er der selvfølgelig dem, der præsterer det dobbelte, og dem, der snart runder 1 mio. kr. om måneden (hvor deres ansatte udfører opgaven, ansatte de også får oplært på skolen)

Et opslag skal jo have en fængende overskrift, men for at forklare den: Modellen har været udgangspunktet for, at vi har hjulpet mange af vores elever til at blive blandt de 1 % rigeste i deres aldersgruppe. Typisk folk, der ikke passede ind i den traditionelle skole.

Kort sagt er det grundlaget for Vinduespudserskolen. Med systemer og intensiv træning, fra håndværket nede på skolen til hele forretningen, fx at sælge til højere priser og med hyppigere intervaller, optimerer vi for eleverne. Vi er et fuldtidsteam, der ikke laver andet end at støtte, udvikle og træne vores elever i det, de har brug for.

Når eleverne har lært at sælge gode priser, gode intervaller og mange naboer, hjælper vi dem også med at reinvestere en del i tiltag som Meta Ads. Det må dog aldrig være deres eneste kilde til nye kunder.

Det er her, du kommer ind

Malte står i dag for at køre annoncer for en lang række elever. De sidste 4 år har han ikke lavet andet end at skaffe de bedste kunder til vinduespudserfirmaer, så han har en stor specialviden på området. Nu er vi nået dertil, hvor vi gerne vil have en ekstra person med på teamet til at arbejde sammen med Malte.

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med Meta Ads, som du kan vise frem. Google Ads er et plus, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du aldrig bliver helt tilfreds og hele tiden vil finde ud af, hvordan en kampagne kan blive bedre.

Du følger med i, hvad der sker med AI, og bruger det aktivt, fx med Make, til at automatisere rapportering og de opgaver, vi gør igen og igen. Ikke for at gøre tingene med hovedet under armen, men for at frigive tid, så vi kan bruge den på det, der gør en forskel for eleverne: at forstå dem, tale med dem og give dem et bedre og mere personligt produkt.

Du kommer til at holde møder med eleverne og være med på hele funnelen, fra annonce til hjemmeside. Hjemmesiderne udliciterer vi i dag, men dem vil vi gerne lave selv fremover. Og så skal du have lyst til at blive rigtig dygtig til ét område.

Opfylder du ikke alle punkter, men kan du genkende dig selv i det meste, så søg alligevel.

Hvem du er

Du starter med en intensiv oplæring. Vi forestiller os, at du tager ansvar for det, du har lovet en elev, og leverer det. Du er punktlig med dine aftaler og forventer det samme af andre. Og du kan lide at arbejde i et team.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst team, der gerne vil have, at du udvikler dig sammen med os. Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Stillingen er på fuldtid, og du arbejder fysisk fra vores kontor ved Vesterport i København. Vi vil gerne have dig med hurtigst muligt.

Sådan søger du

Før du søger, så gå ind på Vinduespudserskolens YouTube og få et indtryk af, hvilken type virksomhed vi er.

Send derefter en kort ansøgning til job@vinduespudserskolen.dk med emnet "Paid Social – dit navn". Fortæl os, hvorfor du mener, du er den rette til jobbet.

jobs.title: Residential Care Worker
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs. No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs. You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism. Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard. Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment. Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing. Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures. Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling. Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care. Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed. Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery. Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team. Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members. Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers. Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans. Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures. Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

jobs.title: Business Controller – bli med og bygg økonomifunksjonen i Podtown
jobs.description:
Business Controller – bli med og bygg økonomifunksjonen i Podtown

Vil du jobbe tett på ledelsen, internasjonale prosjekter og beslutningene som faktisk betyr noe?

Podtown er i sterk utvikling og bygger nå organisasjonen for neste fase. Vi utvikler og leverer modulære rom- og infrastrukturløsninger til krevende markeder som forsvar og beredskap. Nå søker vi en Business Controller som vil få en sentral rolle i selskapet – tett på ledelsen, prosjektene og den operative virksomheten.

Dette er ikke en tradisjonell controllerrolle hvor hovedoppgaven er å rapportere på det som allerede har skjedd. Vi ser etter deg som vil forstå hva som skjer i virksomheten, se fremover og bidra til bedre beslutninger.

Regnskapet håndteres i stor grad eksternt. Din viktigste jobb blir derfor å sørge for at Podtown har kontroll på prosjektøkonomi, likviditet, prognoser, marginer og økonomiske beslutningsgrunnlag. Rollen skal være Podtowns interne økonomiske kontrollpunkt og en viktig sparringspartner for ledelsen.

En rolle med reell påvirkning

Podtown har en liten og kompetent organisasjon og arbeider med komplekse leveranser mot internasjonale kunder. Selskapet har etablert seg i forsvarsmarkedet og står foran en fase hvor både prosjektene og organisasjonen skal skaleres.

Som Business Controller får du en bred rolle. Du vil blant annet:

  • etablere og følge opp prosjektbudsjetter, faktiske kostnader, committed cost, forecast, inntekter og marginer

  • bygge og følge opp rullerende likviditets- og cash flow-prognoser

  • analysere avvik og bidra til at tiltak blir satt inn tidlig

  • etablere en enkel og robust struktur for månedsrapportering, periodiseringer og avsetninger

  • arbeide tett med prosjektansvarlige, leverandører og produksjonspartnere for å forstå kostnadsdrivere, kapasitet og risiko

  • utarbeide økonomiske beslutningsgrunnlag og rapportering til CEO, styre og eiere

  • støtte selskapet i dialog med bank, revisor, regnskapsfører og øvrige rådgivere

  • bidra i finansierings-, garanti-, forsikrings- og kapitalprosesser

  • bygge Podtowns egne økonomiske arbeidsprosesser og systemer etter hvert som virksomheten vokser.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du har noen års erfaring fra controlling, prosjektøkonomi eller økonomistyring og nå ønsker deg nærmere både virksomheten og beslutningene.

Du kan for eksempel arbeide som Business Controller, Project Controller, prosjektøkonom eller Financial Controller i dag. Erfaring fra prosjektbasert virksomhet, industri, maritim sektor, energi eller tilsvarende vil være relevant, men er ikke et absolutt krav.

Vi ser særlig etter deg som har:

  • høyere utdanning innen økonomi, finans eller regnskap

  • gjerne rundt 3–7 års relevant erfaring

  • god forståelse for regnskap og økonomiske sammenhenger

  • interesse for prosjektøkonomi, likviditet, prognoser og business partnering

  • gode ferdigheter i Excel og god systemforståelse

  • evne til å gjøre økonomiske problemstillinger forståelige og beslutningsrelevante.

Like viktig er hvordan du jobber.

Du trives i et miljø med tempo, korte beslutningsveier og tydelige forventninger. Du er selvstendig nok til å drive egne områder fremover, men samtidig trygg nok til å diskutere, utfordre og sparre med ledelsen når tallene tilsier det.

Du trenger ikke være den som alltid har det mest kompliserte regnearket. Viktigere er det at du forstår hva tallene betyr, ser hva som krever handling og klarer å gjøre økonomiske problemstillinger konkrete og beslutningsrelevante.

Vi tror du vil lykkes godt i rollen dersom du:

  • tar eierskap og følger opp til ting faktisk er ferdige

  • arbeider strukturert og trives med ansvar

  • er analytisk, men også pragmatisk og løsningsorientert

  • kommuniserer tydelig på både norsk og engelsk, og tør å stå for egne faglige vurderinger

    bygger gode relasjoner og samarbeider godt på tvers

  • trives med frihet innen tydelige rammer

Hvorfor Podtown?

Dette er en sjelden mulighet til å komme inn på et tidspunkt hvor du faktisk kan være med og forme hvordan økonomifunksjonen skal fungere.

Du får:

  • stor påvirkning og kort vei fra analyse til beslutning

  • tett samarbeid med CEO, COO og selskapets ledelse

  • ansvar for økonomien i komplekse og internasjonale prosjekter

  • innsikt i et spennende marked med krevende kunder og leveranser

  • mulighet til å bygge systemer, arbeidsprosesser og rapportering – ikke bare overta dem

  • en rolle som kan utvikle seg mot et bredere økonomiansvar etter hvert som Podtown vokser.

Du vil få betydelig ansvar og handlingsrom, samtidig som det forventes fremdrift, kvalitet og selvstendighet i rollen.

Podtown passer særlig godt for deg som ønsker mer ansvar og større påvirkning enn du typisk får som én av mange controllere i et større konsern.

In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Key Responsibilities Occupational Health Management -Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the company’s occupational health strategy. -Develop and maintain workplace health risk assessments, health surveillance programmes, and medical screening initiatives in line with statutory requirements. -Coordinate pre-employment health assessments, return-to-work evaluations, and fitness-for-task assessments. -Advise management on occupational health risks, control measures, and workplace adjustments. Employee Well-Being and Support -Develop evidence-based well-being programmes covering mental health, stress management, resilience, ergonomics, lifestyle health, and related areas. -Oversee the provision of Employee Assistance Programmes (EAPs) and other support services. -Promote a culture of well-being through awareness campaigns, training, and engagement activities. Safety, Compliance & Policy Development -Ensure organisational compliance with relevant Irish legislation, including the Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Act and industry-specific regulations. -Develop, update, and implement occupational health and well-being policies and procedures. -Provide expert guidance on incident management, workplace accommodations, and ergonomic assessments. -Maintain accurate and confidential health records in accordance with GDPR and professional standards. Strategic Leadership -Contribute to organisational strategy by integrating health and well-being objectives with business goals. -Lead cross-functional initiatives related to health and safety culture improvement. -Analyse occupational health data and produce regular reports for senior management. Training & Education -Deliver or coordinate training on occupational health, mental health awareness, ergonomics, hazard identification, and other relevant topics. -Build capacity among managers and employees to support health and well-being initiatives. Stakeholder Engagement -Liaise with internal and external stakeholders, including senior management, HR, health professionals, insurers, regulatory bodies, and safety representatives. -Manage relationships with third-party occupational health providers and specialists. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) -Effective delivery of occupational health and well-being programmes. Compliance with all relevant legislation and internal policies. -Reduction in workplace health risks and improvement in employee well-being metrics. -Timely reporting and accurate maintenance of health-related documentation. -Positive engagement and participation in well-being initiatives. -Contribution to a demonstrably improved health and safety culture. Qualification and Experience required : - Degree in health, medical, dental or relevant. - An elective 0 to 2 years work experience in similar area, field, role - Training shall be provided on job

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, SSCS: Supply Chain
Welders, Offshore; Denmark - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to work on some of the largest Oil & Gas projects in the Danish sector of the North Sea? Have you been looking to join a company in growth with many opportunities for employment and great job security? Do you also want to have more time for your private life?
Then you are the one we have been looking for!

We are looking for welders for offshore work in the Danish sector. Throughout the year we will be adding 250 more workers to our manpower pool.

Your position
We offer you a unique opportunity to join Semco Maritime during our largest growth phase yet. You will be working in a turn based 2:2 or a 2:3 which means you will spend 2 weeks offshore and the 2 to 3 following weeks at home. That also means you will have a work/life balance most people will be envious of, because during the 2 weeks of the rotational period that you are home you can dedicate yourself fully to your family, your hobbies, and your passions.

Your tasks & responsibilities
Together with your team you will be playing a key part in ensuring the quality of our costumers’ offshore assets.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Carrying out daily tasks related to welding and pipefitting
  • Assisting the mechanical team if needed
  • Helping out the other teams when necessary

Qualifications
We imagine that you are good at teamwork and that you work with attention to detail. Furthermore, you should be comfortable with routine tasks and working with predefined processes and guidelines. It is important that you possess a safety-first mindset.

To be successful in this position we expect that you have the following qualifications:

  • Educated/trained welder, smith, mechanic, pipefitter or similar
  • Experience with welding processes 141, 111, 136
  • Availability to pass site tests
  • Preferably have offshore experience


Welcome to Semco Maritime
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and sustainable solutions globally.

There are opportunities for personal and professional development within the job. Furthermore, Semco Maritime is in growth so there are job opportunities for permanent employment.

There are both permanent positions and long duration project positions available.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions for the position, contact Stine Jessen at +45 79 16 66 66.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company dedicated to projects in the energy sector. For 40 years, we have been facilitating design, fabrication, service and maintenance of our customers’ assets, providing comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects. From turnkey engineering solutions to outsourcing of manpower and delivery of components, systems and solutions – we make sure our customers and partners in the energy sector experience safe and cost-efficient solutions. Semco Maritime has approx. 1,900 employees and branches in Denmark, Norway, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore and the US. For further information, please see www.semcomaritime.com.

jobs.title: Area Manager – Main Component Exchanges (f/m/d); Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, DK - Aarhus, Germany , DE - Bremen, DE - Hamburg, DE - Emden
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced leader with a strong track record in offshore wind operations, service delivery, or project execution? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where safety, customer focus, and operational excellence go hand in hand? Then we look forward to your application as Area Manager (f/m/d) for Main Component Exchanges!

Your position
In your new position as Area Manager (f/m/d) for the Main Component Exchanges, you will lead the regional delivery of our offshore MCE business across Northern & Central Europe or the UK. You will be accountable for regional performance and play a key role in ensuring the successful execution of complex offshore campaigns.

The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel regularly depending on your main place of work. The projects are typically short- and long-term service contracts for our clients in Northern and Central Europe as well as the UK.

Your tasks & responsibilities
As Area Manager (f/m/d), you will be responsible for the overall performance of your region and ensure that customer commitments are delivered safely, efficiently, and predictably. You will provide leadership across Project Management, Operational Management, and Marine Operations while maintaining strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders. The role combines strategic oversight with operational leadership and serves as the primary escalation point within the region.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Leading regional project and operational delivery performance
  • Ensuring successful delivery of customer commitments regarding safety, quality, schedule, and cost
  • Prioritizing resources and resolving cross-project conflicts
  • Managing customer, operational, and project escalations
  • Supporting strategic workload and capability planning
  • Driving collaboration across Project Management, Operational Management, and Marine Operations
  • Ensuring implementation of the MCE operating model across the region
  • Supporting Sales & Business Development through customer, market and operational expertise


Your profile & qualifications
We are looking for an experienced and communicative Area Manager (f/m/d) who is passionate about Main Component Exchanges within Offshore Wind and wants to take ownership. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related discipline
  • Proven leadership experience in offshore wind, marine operations, energy services, or a comparable industry
  • Strong understanding of project delivery, operations, and customer management
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and decision-making skills
  • A strong HSEQ mindset and commitment to safe execution
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken


Welcome to Semco Maritime
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Specialarbejder/maskinfører til Miljøcenter i Kolding
jobs.description:
Meldgaard har i mange år sorteret og håndteret affald, jord og genbrugsprodukter. I dag har vi miljøcentre/modtageanlæg i bl.a. Kolding, Klintholm, Herning og posesortering i Aalborg. Afdelingerne har været igennem en kraftig udvikling med masser af nye aktiviteter i en spændende branche.

Hovedaktiviteterne på pladserne er håndtering af jord, have/park-affald, pap/papir og øvrige affaldsfraktioner, der kommer ind på de forskellige pladser. 

Vi har en uformel omgangstone med gensidig respekt for hinanden og har med udgangspunkt fra kontoret i Kolding tæt kontakt med alle modtageanlæg samt vores hovedkontor i Aabenraa. Vi er et stærkt team med en ambition om at have tilfredse kunder og levere kvalitet hver gang.

Jobbet

Vi søger en specialarbejder til drift af vores helt nye presse på vores miljøcenter i Kolding. 
Du vil komme til at beskæftige dig med at overvåge pressen og kørsel af maskiner (gummiged, materialehåndteringsmaskine og gaffeltruck). Derudover vil du stå for sortering samt drift og vedligeholdelse af pladsen, pressen, maskiner samt alle forefaldende opgaver. Disse opgaver løses i samarbejde med driftslederen samt dine kommende kollegaer. 

Stillingen er på 37 timer, og arbejdstiden vil ligge mellem kl. 07.00 – 16.00.

Du vil blive en del af et lille team, hvor vi er hurtige til at træffe beslutninger og få opgaverne løst.

Om dig

Du har interesse og god forståelse for teknik samt maskiner og deres funktion. Dine hænder er skruet godt på, og du har erfaring eller interesse for kørsel af ballepresse, entreprenør- eller landbrugsmaskiner. Du elsker nye udfordringer, er omstillingsparat og vil gerne lære nyt. Du tager ejerskab i dit job og brænder for at gøre en forskel. 

Det er samtidig vigtigt at du: 
  • Er maskinfører
  • Kendskab til affaldssortering er en fordel
  • Har kørekort kategori B 
  • Fordel hvis du har erfaring med ballepresse
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig er en god teamplayer
  • Har godt humør
  • Har truckcertifikat
  • Er fleksibel

Hos Meldgaard kan vi tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende stilling med gode løn- og ansættelsesforhold. Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje. 

Har du uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte driftsleder Connie Westphal på tlf. 52 18 71 23.
Eller send os din ansøgning via Søg stillingen senest den 30. oktober 2026
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og afslutter processen når den rette kandidat er fundet. Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Dette er ikkje ei tradisjonell stilling innan eitt fagområde!
jobs.description:
Osland-konsernet er et av landets eldste akvakulturselskaper med hovedkontor i Bjordal, Høyanger. Konsernet driver en helhetlig verdikjede innen produksjon av ørret – fra genetikk og settefisk til matfiskproduksjon.

 

Vi søkjer ein strukturert og allsidig medarbeider som skal arbeide på tvers av konsernet.

 

Dette er ei brei og operativ rolle. Du vil støtte fleire fagområde og bidra til at oppgåver blir følgde opp på ein god og systematisk måte. Du vil jobbe med digitalisering og forenkling. Du motiveres av å skape struktur, sikre kvalitet og finne smartere og mer effektive måter å arbeide på.

 

Rolla passar for deg som likar variasjon. Du må trivast med å arbeide med både detaljar og større problemstillingar. Du vil få bred innsikt i selskapets verksemd og være bidragsyter for felles leveranser i konsernet.

 

Arbeidsoppgåver

 

Du vil få oppgåver innan fleire delar av verksemda, både innen verksemdsstyring og prosjekt. Innhaldet vil utvikle seg over tid.

 

Aktuelle arbeidsoppgåver vil vere:

  • Planlegging og gjennomføring av administrasjonsoppgaver
  • Ansvar for vedlikehold og arbeid i kvalitetssystem og interne rutinar etter årshjul
  • Forenkle og effektivisere administrative arbeidsprosesser, blant annet med bruk av KI.
  • Følge opp at lover, krav og interne retningslinjer blir etterlevd
  • Arbeid med rapportering fra prosjekt og støtte til prosjektorganisasjon i utviklingarbeid
  • Planlegge og drive mindre prosjekt, utviklingstiltak og forbedringsarbeid.
  • Støtte og oppfølging i revisjoner, kontroller og avvik.
  • Arbeid i system med arkivering, og oversikt over avtalar og dokumentasjon
  • Arbeid i informasjonskanalar og aktiv kommunikasjon
  • Administrativ støtte innan strukturelle system, utvikling og effektivisering
  • Innhente, strukturere dokumentasjon og styringsinformasjon på tvers av konsernet
  • Støtte økonomiarbeid med rapportering, dokumentasjon og oppfølging
  • Deltaking i prosjekt og forbetringsarbeid

 

Kven ser vi etter?

 

Vi ser etter ein person som er strukturert og nøyaktig. Du må like å få oversikt og sørgje for framdrift. Du har evne til å gripe om deg og er uredd i tilnærming til et større omfang.

 

Du arbeider sjølvstendig og er datakyndig. Samstundes må du kunne samarbeide godt med ulike delar av organisasjonen.

 

Vi ser gjerne at du har utdanning eller erfaring innan eitt eller fleire av desse områda:

 

  • Økonomi og administrasjon
  • Kvalitet eller HMS, juridiske/organisatoriske fag
  • Havbruksledelse

Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning.

 

Det viktigaste er at du har god forretningsforståing. Du må også vere komfortabel med å setje deg inn i nye fagområde og kunne sjå heilheten av kontinuerlig forbedring. Du er god i microsoft verktøy og spesielt Office 365.

 

Vi trur du vil lykkast dersom du

  • Arbeider systematisk og tek ansvar
  • Har høg gjennomføringsevne
  • Er god til å halde oversikt
  • Kommuniserer klart og presist
  • Behandlar konfidensiell informasjon på ein trygg måte
  • Likar å finne praktiske løysingar

 

Ei rolle med stor breidde

 

Dette er ikkje ei tradisjonell stilling innan eitt fagområde.

 

Du vil arbeide i skjeringspunktet mellom kvalitet, etterleving og administrasjon. Du vil også støtte arbeid innan økonomi, HR, KHMS og juridiske saker. Vi er spesielt interessert dersom du har arbeid i skjeringspunktet mellom produksjon, økonomi og andre datautrekk.

 

Rolla gir derfor stor innsikt i korleis konsernet blir drive.

 

For den rette personen vil det vere gode moglegheiter til å utvikle både rolla og ansvarsområdet.

 

Vi tilbyr

 

  • Gode muligheter til å påvirke og videreutvikle konsernets prosesser og digitale løsninger.
  • Moderne systemer og digitale verktøy, samt gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og videreutdanning.
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og et stabilt og utviklende arbeidsmiljø ved vårt avdelingskontor i Sandviken, Bergen.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte vår rekrutteringsrådgiver i Lederhuset AS, Bjarne Jacobsen.

jobs.title: HSEQ Manager - Balance of Plant; Location: DK - Esbjerg, UK - Grimsby
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced HSEQ professional with a passion for renewable energy and safe project delivery? Do you want to help shape safe, compliant and efficient Balance of Plant projects? Join us and become an energy pioneer in the industry!

Your position

In your new position as HSEQ Manager BoP, you will be a key member of our Renewables HSEQ function, supporting safe and compliant Balance of Plant project delivery across offshore wind projects. You will provide first-line HSEQ leadership, guide and support HSEQ Advisors, and work closely with Project Managers, the Head of BoP and operational teams to ensure HSEQ requirements are embedded from tender and pre-project preparation through to execution, reporting and lessons learned.

We are not just looking for someone who is technically qualified and experienced; we are looking for someone who shares our view of safety.

As part of the recruitment process, we will discuss how you see New View safety concepts, including Safety I and Safety II, HOP, and Safety Differently, working together to deliver safe outcomes. We will also explore how you believe the right information can be provided to the right people, whether that is controls for frontline workers, data for support teams, or due diligence information for leadership teams. In addition, we will discuss your perspective on the role of the HSEQ team in enabling learning, supporting operations and strengthening safe delivery.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As HSEQ Manager BoP, you will be responsible for supporting safe, compliant and efficient project delivery from sales and pre-project kick-off preparation through to project execution, operational learning, customer support and knowledge sharing.

  • Preparing and managing project-specific HSEQ documentation, including Project HSEQ Plans, Construction Phase Plans, emergency response plans, bridging documents, RAMS, LOTO input and supporting reference documents.

  • Supporting sales, tenders and project planning by reviewing contracts, identifying HSEQ deliverables and ensuring adequate costs and resources are planned for required HSEQ activities.

  • Preparing and contributing to kick-off meetings, project meetings and HSEQ presentations, ensuring relevant safety rules, evacuation arrangements, reporting requirements, initiatives, safety alerts and lessons learned are communicated.

  • Monitoring project execution, including completion of emergency response drill plans, weather day training plans, site visit quality, Synergy use, EFA kit compliance, action follow-up and investigation quality.

  • Leading or supporting significant investigations, ensuring clear descriptions, root causes, contributing factors, control measures and corrective and preventative actions are identified, tracked and closed effectively.

  • Maintaining professional relationships with client representatives, supporting positive safety culture, encouraging reporting and learning, and facilitating end-of-project lessons learned.



Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured, proactive and collaborative HSEQ professional who is passionate about offshore renewable energy and wants to leave their mark on safe project execution. You take ownership of HSEQ standards, are confident engaging with operational and project stakeholders, and can balance operational essentials with learning-focused activities that improve safety outcomes.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • Solid HSEQ experience within offshore wind, marine, construction, renewables or other project-based operational environments.

  • Experience preparing, reviewing and maintaining HSEQ documentation such as RAMS, HSEQ plans, emergency response plans, drill plans, investigation reports and lessons learned material.

  • Confidence supporting tenders, contract reviews, project kick-off activities and HSEQ input to operational planning.

  • Experience guiding, supporting or leading HSEQ Advisors or site-based HSEQ personnel.

  • Strong investigation, reporting and follow-up skills, with the ability to identify trends, communicate areas of concern and drive actions through to completion.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work closely with Project Managers, clients, offshore teams and senior HSEQ leadership.



Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we are energy pioneers - working together to create a sustainable energy future through our innovative solutions and services. With us, you will be part of a community of over 2,000 dedicated people who are driving change and making a real difference in meeting the world's growing energy demand.

You will experience an international, inclusive and inspiring workplace where diversity, collaboration and a healthy work-life balance are not just buzzwords but integrated values that drive our success. We offer flexible working arrangements, on-site fitness facilities, and tasty, organic food in our canteen that will have your taste buds singing. Plus, we like to have fun along the way with lots of fun social activities!

Your place of work can be based either in the UK or Denmark, with regular collaboration across our international teams. The position is full-time, and you can expect travel to project and offshore locations as required, including site visits in line with project needs.

Become an energy pioneer

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.

Let’s drive change together. Apply today to leave your mark on the global energy industry.

We cannot wait to hear from you!

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.
